source: • 你令你能看见的天空中的一个部分出现至多10个字。文字看起来是由云彩构成的，并在法术的持续时间内留在原位。文字将会在法术终结时消失。强风可以吹散云彩，令法术提前终止。

source:
你在施法距离内创造一个物件，一名生物，或是其他可视现象的幻象，此幻象在满足特定触发条件时会被激活。该幻象在被激活前无法被察觉。幻象必须不大于30尺立方，且由你决定幻术如何行动和发声。这种按脚本执行的表演可以持续至多5分钟。
当你指定的触发条件发生时，幻象会迅速成型，并以你设定的方式运作。幻术终止运作之后，它消失并休眠10分钟，在休眠结束之后幻象便可再次被激活。
触发条件可以宽泛也可以按你喜好进行细化，但必须是发生在距幻象区域30尺内的能看到或听到的现象。例如，你可以制造一个自己的幻象，在其他人试图打开一扇卡住的门时出现并发出警告。
由于东西可以穿过幻象，任何与该幻象进行的物理互动都会暴露其幻觉本质。一名生物可以用一个研究动作进行一次对抗你法术豁免DC的成功智力（调查）检定以看穿幻象。辨出幻象的生物可以看穿该影像，其产生的声响对该生物而言显得虚假。
target:
Within range, you create an illusion of an object, a creature, or another visible phenomenon. The illusion activates when a specified trigger occurs. The illusion is imperceptible until it activates. It must fit within a 30-foot Cube, and you decide how it moves and sounds. This scripted performance can last up to 5 minutes.
When your specified trigger occurs, the illusion rapidly takes form and performs as you designed. When the performance ends, the illusion disappears and remains dormant for 10 minutes, after which it can be activated again.
The trigger can be as broad or as specific as you like, but it must be a visible or audible phenomenon that occurs within 30 feet of the illusion's area. For example, you could create an illusion of yourself that appears and gives a warning when someone tries to open a stuck door.
Physical interaction with the illusion reveals its illusory nature, since things can pass through it. A creature can take a Study action and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern the illusion. A creature that recognizes the illusion can see through the image, and its sounds seem false to that creature.
note: All four source paragraphs, trigger distances, five-minute performance, ten-minute dormancy, and Study-action check are preserved. The opening is split into two sentences to make the range and activation refer clearly to the illusion, matching the source two clauses without changing mechanics.

source:
你唤来一个邪魔灵魄。其使用下文邪魔灵魄的数据，并会在施法距离内一处你可见的未被占据的空间中显现。当你施展法术时，从魔鬼，恶魔，尤格罗斯魔中选择一类，该生物会显现为你所选的那类邪魔中的一员，其数据中的部分特性也受此影响。该生物会在生命值降为0或是法术结束时消失。
该生物是你的盟友（对你的其它盟友亦是如此）。它在战斗中使用你的先攻，并在你回合结束后立即行动。它遵从于你的口头指令（无需任何动作）。如果你不发令，它将执行回避动作并远离危险。
升环施法：该生物的数据使用新的法术环阶。

邪魔灵魄Fiendish Spirit 
大型邪魔，绝对中立
AC 12+法术环阶
HP 50（仅恶魔）或40（仅魔鬼）或60（仅尤格罗斯魔）+每比6环高的法术环阶15点
速度40尺；攀爬40尺（仅恶魔）；飞行60尺（仅魔鬼）
力量13|+1|+1 敏捷16|+3|+3 体质15|+2|+2
智力10|+0|+0 感知10|+0|+0 魅力16|+3|+3
抗性：火焰
免疫：毒素；中毒
感官：黑暗视觉60尺，被动察觉10
语言：深渊语，炼狱语，心灵感应60尺
CR无（XP0；PB等于你的熟练加值）
特质Traits
焚身爆Death Throes（仅恶魔）。当灵魄生命值降值0时，或是法术结束时，灵魄会爆炸。敏捷豁免：DC等于你的法术豁免DC，以灵魄为源点10尺光环区域内的每个生物。失败：2d10+法术环阶的火焰伤害。成功：半伤。
魔鬼视界Devil‘s Sight（仅魔鬼）。魔法黑暗不会阻碍灵魄的黑暗视觉。
魔法抗性Magical Resistance。灵魄为抵抗法术和其他魔法效应而作的豁免检定具有优势。
动作Actions
多重攻击Multiattack。灵魄发动等于法术环阶一半次数的攻击（向下取整）。
啃咬Bite（仅恶魔）。近战攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺。命中：1d12+3+法术环阶的暗蚀伤害。
爪击Claws（仅尤格罗斯魔）。近战攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺。命中：1d8+3+法术环阶的挥砍伤害。不论是否命中，那之后灵魄可以立即魔法性地传送至多30尺至一处它可见且未被占据的空间。
狂焰袭Fiery Strike（仅魔鬼）。近战或远程攻击：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺或射程150尺。命中：2d6+3+法术环阶的火焰伤害。
target:
You call forth a fiendish spirit. It uses the Fiendish Spirit stat block below and appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast the spell, choose Devil, Demon, or Yugoloth. The creature manifests as a member of that kind of Fiend, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when its Hit Points drop to 0 or the spell ends.
The creature is your ally and an ally of your other allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands, which require no action. If you give it no commands, it takes the Dodge action and moves away from danger.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Use the new spell level in the creature's stat block.

Fiendish Spirit
Large Fiend, Neutral
AC 12 + the spell's level
HP 50 (Demon only), 40 (Devil only), or 60 (Yugoloth only), plus 15 for each spell level above 6
Speed 40 feet; Climb 40 feet (Demon only); Fly 60 feet (Devil only)
Strength 13|+1|+1 Dexterity 16|+3|+3 Constitution 15|+2|+2
Intelligence 10|+0|+0 Wisdom 10|+0|+0 Charisma 16|+3|+3
Resistances: Fire
Immunities: Poison; Poisoned
Senses: Darkvision 60 feet, Passive Perception 10
Languages: Abyssal, Infernal, Telepathy 60 feet
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)
Traits
Death Throes (Demon Only). When the spirit's Hit Points drop to 0 or the spell ends, the spirit explodes. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the spirit. Failure: 2d10 + the spell's level Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
Devil's Sight (Devil Only). Magical Darkness doesn't impede the spirit's Darkvision.
Magical Resistance. The spirit has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Actions
Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half the spell's level, rounded down.
Bite (Demon Only). Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 feet. Hit: 1d12 + 3 + the spell's level Necrotic damage.
Claws (Yugoloth Only). Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 feet. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level Slashing damage. Hit or miss, the spirit can then immediately teleport magically up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
Fiery Strike (Devil Only). Melee or Ranged Attack: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 feet or range 150 feet. Hit: 2d6 + 3 + the spell's level Fire damage.
note: The entire supplied stat block is translated, including all six score/modifier/save triples, three forms, all HP bases, and Death Throes on either 0 HP or spell ending. The supplied English trait label Magical Resistance is retained. No ability or restriction is imported from another edition.

source:
一道阳炎射线从你手中射出并形成一条5尺宽、60尺长的线状区域。所有区域内的生物必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败者将受到6d8点光耀伤害，并且在你的下一回合前陷入目盲状态。豁免成功则伤害减半，且不会陷入目盲。
你可以在法术终止前的任一回合内以一个魔法动作重新创造一道线状光芒。
在法术持续时间内，你的手中一点散发出耀眼的光芒。其光耀为周围提供 30 尺的明亮光照，以及该范围外 30 尺的微光光照。这些光芒均视为等同于阳光。
target:
A beam of sunlight shoots from your hand in a Line 5 feet wide and 60 feet long. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d8 Radiant damage and has the Blinded condition until your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't Blinded.
On any of your turns before the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to create another Line of light.
For the duration, a point in your hand shines with dazzling light, shedding Bright Light for 30 feet and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. This light counts as sunlight.
note: The source's blindness endpoint is simply until your next turn; a more specific start/end timing is not supplied. All line dimensions, damage, and light distances are retained.

source:
你咒唤一口充满冒泡液体的爪足大锅。大锅出现在距你5尺内地面上的一处未占空间内且持续存在至法术终止。大锅不能被移动，且在法术结束时与其内的冒泡液体一同消失。
大锅中的液体会复制一种你选择的稀有度为普通或非普通药剂（如一瓶治疗药水Potion of Healing）的词条。用一个附赠动作，你或一名盟友可以从大锅中捞出上述你所选择的一种药水。药水会被装在一个小瓶中，且小瓶会在药水被消耗后消失。大锅能产生药水的瓶数等同于你的施法属性调整值（最小为1）。从大锅中取出最后一瓶药水后，大锅消失，法术终止。
从大锅中取出的药水若在你再次施展此法术时未被消耗，则药水会消失。
target:
You conjure a claw-footed cauldron filled with bubbling liquid. The cauldron appears on the ground in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you and lasts until the spell ends. It can't be moved and disappears along with its bubbling liquid when the spell ends.
The cauldron's liquid replicates the entry for one Common or Uncommon potion of your choice, such as a Potion of Healing. As a Bonus Action, you or an ally can draw one potion of the chosen kind from the cauldron. The potion comes in a vial that disappears when the potion is consumed. The cauldron can produce a number of potions equal to your spellcasting ability modifier, with a minimum of 1. When the last potion is drawn, the cauldron disappears and the spell ends.
Any potion drawn from the cauldron that hasn't been consumed disappears when you cast this spell again.
note: Preserves the single chosen potion kind, Common/Uncommon rarity, immovable cauldron, modifier-based quantity, and recasting expiry without adding a separate potion expiry.

source: 该法术在施法距离内一棵体型不超过大型的未活化植物与同位面上任意距离外的另一棵植物之间创造一道魔法连接。施法时，你必须见过或触碰过出口植物至少一次。在持续时间内，任何生物都可以花费5尺移动力进入目标植物内，然后从出口植物处出来。
target: This spell creates a magical link between one inanimate plant within range that is no larger than Large and another plant any distance away on the same plane. When you cast the spell, you must have seen or touched the destination plant at least once. For the duration, any creature can spend 5 feet of movement to enter the target plant and emerge from the destination plant.
note: The source explicitly says no larger than Large; this upper size limit is preserved, not reversed using another rules version. Same-plane requirement and prior sight or touch both retained.

source:
你在施法距离内一块坚实的地面上创造出一面冰墙。你可以将它塑成半球状或球状（半径最长10尺），也可以塑成一个由十个10尺×10尺的方板块构成的平面。每块板块都必须要和至少一块其他板块相连。不管形状如何，冰墙总是厚1尺并持续存在至法术终止。
如果冰墙形成时穿过了某生物所占据的空间，则该生物会被推到冰墙的一侧（由你来决定是哪一侧）且必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败，受到10d6点冷冻伤害。豁免成功，则只受一半伤害。
作为一个物件，冰墙可以因受到伤害而被打破。冰墙的AC为12，每段10尺长的冰墙有30点生命值，而且冰墙具有寒冷、毒素和心灵伤害的免疫，以及火焰伤害的易伤。当一段10尺长的冰墙的生命值降至0时，这段冰墙就会被摧毁，但原地会留下一片冰冷刺骨的空气。
生物在一个回合内第一次通过这片寒气时，必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败，受到5d6点冷冻伤害。豁免成功，则只受一半伤害。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比六环高一环，冰墙产生时造成的伤害就提高2d6，穿越冰冷刺骨的空气造成的伤害就增加1d6。
target:
You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You can form it into a hemisphere or sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or a flat surface made of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must adjoin at least one other panel. In any form, the wall is 1 foot thick and lasts until the spell ends.
If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall, your choice, and must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 10d6 Cold damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
The wall is an object that can be damaged and broken. It has AC 12, and each 10-foot section has 30 Hit Points. It has Immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic damage and Vulnerability to Fire damage. When a 10-foot section drops to 0 Hit Points, that section is destroyed and leaves behind a sheet of frigid air.
A creature that passes through this frigid air for the first time on a turn must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d6 Cold damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: For each slot level above level six, the damage dealt when the wall appears increases by 2d6, and the damage for passing through the frigid air increases by 1d6.
note: Both damage events, their different saves, all wall dimensions, defenses, and separate upcast increments are retained. Chinese-written ten and six are translated as English words to leave the original Arabic number tokens directly comparable.

source:
你创造出一面坚韧、纠缠、长满锐利棘刺的灌木之墙。棘墙出现在施法距离内一处固体表面上并且持续存在至法术终止。你可以选择创造长不过60尺、高不过10尺、厚不过5尺的直墙；或是直径不过20尺、高不过20尺、厚不过5尺的环形墙。此外，棘墙还会阻挡视线。
棘墙出现时所有位于其内的生物要进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败，受到7d8点穿刺伤害。豁免成功，则只受一半伤害。
生物可以移动穿过棘墙，但这是个十分缓慢且痛苦的过程。生物在棘墙中每移动 1 尺要消耗 4 尺的移动力。另外，生物在一个回合内首次进入棘墙或在棘墙所占据的区域内结束其回合时，必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败，受到7d8点挥砍伤害。豁免成功，则只受一半伤害。一名生物一回合只进行一次此豁免。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比六环高一环，造成的伤害就提高1d8。
target:
You create a wall of tough, tangled brush bristling with sharp thorns. The wall appears on a solid surface within range and lasts until the spell ends. You can make a straight wall up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ring up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight.
Each creature in the wall's area when it appears must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 7d8 Piercing damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
A creature can move through the wall, but doing so is slow and painful. Each 1 foot of movement through the wall costs 4 feet of movement. In addition, a creature that enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn in the wall's space must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 7d8 Slashing damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above level six.
note: Retains the source's distinct initial Piercing and later Slashing damage, both Dexterity saves, once-per-turn limit, end-of-turn trigger, and straight/ring height difference.

source:
你和施法距离内你能看见的至多十个自愿生物在法术持续时间内变为气化形态，其外观有如一团云雾。处于该云雾形态的生物具有 300 尺的飞行速度且能够悬浮，免疫倒地状态，并且具有钝击、挥砍、穿刺伤害的抗性。该形态下的生物除疾走和使用魔法动作变回原形以外不能执行其他动作。变回原形需要花1分钟的时间，在这段时间内该生物处于震慑状态。在法术终止前，该生物还可以再次变成云雾形态，而再次使用魔法 动作进行变形同样要花1分钟时间。
如果法术终止时受术目标正以云雾形态飞行，则该目标将在1分钟内以每轮60尺的速度降落直至安全着陆。如果该生物降落1分钟后还没着陆，则在余下的距离中它将会如正常情况一样坠落。
target:
You and up to ten willing creatures you can see within range take on gaseous forms resembling clouds for the duration. A creature in this cloud form has a Fly Speed of 300 feet and can hover, has Immunity to the Prone condition, and has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing damage. In this form, the creature can take only the Dash action or a Magic action to return to its normal form. Returning to normal takes 1 minute, during which the creature has the Stunned condition. Before the spell ends, the creature can transform into cloud form again by taking a Magic action, which also takes 1 minute.
If a target is flying in cloud form when the spell ends, it descends at 60 feet per round for 1 minute until it lands safely. If it hasn't landed after descending for 1 minute, it falls normally for the remaining distance.
note: All action limits, transformation time, Stunned period, three resistances, Prone immunity, and timed descent are preserved. No extra transformation restriction is added.

你和你身边5尺内的至多五个自愿生物一起瞬间传送到一个你事先设置好的圣殿。你和与你一起传送的生物将出现在你准备圣殿时指定的地点（见下）旁边最近的未被占据位置。如果你在施放法术前没有事先准备好圣殿，则该法术将不产生任何效应。
你必须指定一处地方（例如一座寺庙），在那里施放法术以将其设为圣殿。
target:
You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a sanctuary you prepared earlier. You and the creatures traveling with you appear in the nearest unoccupied spaces beside the location you designated when preparing the sanctuary, as described below. If you haven't prepared a sanctuary before casting the spell, the spell has no effect.
You must designate a place, such as a temple, and cast the spell there to establish it as your sanctuary.
note: The supplied sanctuary preparation has no deity or alignment requirement; none is added. Includes the five companions, proximity, nearest spaces, and no-preparation failure.

source:
• 你念动一段咒语，吸收下层位面或上层位面的魔力（由你选择）并变化自身。你获得以下增益直到法术结束。
→你免疫火焰和毒素伤害（下层位面）或光耀和黯蚀伤害（上层位面）。
→你免疫中毒状态（下层位面）或魅惑状态（上层位面）。
→你背后出现灵体翅膀，赋予你40尺飞行速度。
→你的AC获得+2加值。
→你进行的所有武器攻击都带有魔法，且当你进行一次武器攻击时，你可以用你的施法关键属性代替力量值进行攻击检定和伤害掷骰。
→当你在自己的回合进行攻击动作时，你可以攻击两次而非一次。如果已经有类似的能力给予你额外的攻击次数，例如额外攻击Extra Attack，你无视这项增益。
context: column:M;spell:Tasha’s Otherworldly Guise;book:塔莎的万象坩埚;level:6
target:
• You recite an incantation, drawing on the magic of the Lower Planes or the Upper Planes, your choice, to transform yourself. You gain the following benefits until the spell ends.
→ You are immune to Fire and Poison damage (Lower Planes) or Radiant and Necrotic damage (Upper Planes).
→ You are immune to the Poisoned condition (Lower Planes) or the Charmed condition (Upper Planes).
→ Spectral wings appear on your back, giving you a Fly Speed of 40 feet.
→ You gain a +2 bonus to AC.
→ All your weapon attacks are magical. When you make a weapon attack, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls.
→ When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack twice instead of once. Ignore this benefit if you already have a similar ability that grants additional attacks, such as Extra Attack.

source:
• 你令距离内你能看见的地面处升起六根石柱。每根石柱为直径5尺，高度至多30尺的圆柱。升起石柱的地表必须具有足以容纳其直径的空间，你可以以一个体型不超过中型的生物的脚下作为目标。每根石柱的AC为5，具有30点生命值。当其生命值被降为0时，石柱将变为碎石，在10尺半径的区域内形成一片困难地形的区域。每块5尺直径的碎石区域都需要至少1分钟来手动清理。
• 若一根石柱在一个生物的脚下升起，该生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免检定，否则会被石柱顶起。生物可以选择在此豁免中失败。
• 若一根石柱因为天花板或其他障碍未能达到其最大高度，在石柱上的生物受到6d6点钝击伤害，并被束缚，在石柱与障碍物间动弹不得。被束缚的生物可以以一个动作来进行一次力量或敏捷检定（由该生物选择），对抗此法术的豁免检定DC。若成功，该生物不再被束缚，必须选择从石柱上移动下来或摔落下来。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用7环或更高的法术位施放该法术时，使用的法术位每比6环高一环，你便能额外升起两根石柱。
context: column:M;spell:Bones of the Earth;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:6
target:
• You cause six stone pillars to rise from ground you can see within range. Each is a cylinder 5 feet in diameter and up to 30 feet high. The ground must have enough space for a pillar's diameter, and you can target the ground beneath a Medium or smaller creature. Each pillar has AC 5 and 30 hit points. When reduced to 0 hit points, it crumbles into rubble that creates difficult terrain in a 10-foot radius. Each 5-foot-diameter patch of rubble takes at least 1 minute to clear by hand.
• If a pillar rises beneath a creature, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw or be lifted by the pillar. It can choose to fail this save.
• If a ceiling or another obstacle prevents a pillar from reaching its maximum height, a creature on the pillar takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained, trapped between the pillar and the obstacle. A restrained creature can use an action to make a Strength or Dexterity check, its choice, against your spell save DC. On a success, it is no longer restrained and must choose to move or fall off the pillar.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 7 or higher spell slot, you can raise two additional pillars for each slot level above 6.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-005 019e0a25613b156b2855bd1c (2014 M406); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 64370bdfdda60c47544c7d7395d66bb38f018da473b54546c87adaaefb0503f6. Parent contextual note: The source says six pillars rather than up to six, and a 5-foot-diameter rubble patch rather than a square; both are retained. Pillar damage/obstacle restraint, voluntary failed save and escape choice remain distinct.

source:
• 说出复杂咒语的同时，你用一把镶嵌宝石的匕首刺穿自己，并受到不能被任何方式降低的2d4穿刺伤害。随后你将血液滴落在法术的其他成分上并接触它们，将它们转变为一种名为造妖Homunculus的特殊构装体。
• 造妖的数据参见怪物手册。它是你的忠实伙伴，并且会随着你死亡。每次你完成一次长休，并且此时若造妖与你处于同一位面，你可以选择花费最多一半的生命骰，投掷每个骰子并加上你的体质调整值，之后你的最大生命值降低数字的总和，并且造妖的最大生命值和当前生命值都提升这个数字。这个过程可以让你的生命值降至不低于1点。你和造妖的生命值变化会在你完成下一次长休时还原，在那之前你的最大生命降低效果不能被移除，除非你的造妖死亡。
• 同一时间你只能拥有一只造妖。如果你在你的造妖还存活时施展，法术将会失败。
context: column:M;spell:Create Homunculus;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:6
target:
• While speaking an intricate incantation, you pierce yourself with a jewel-encrusted dagger and take 2d4 piercing damage that cannot be reduced by any means. You then drip blood onto the spell's other components and touch them, transforming them into a special construct called a Homunculus.
• Use the Homunculus statistics from the Monster Manual. It is your faithful companion and dies when you do. Whenever you finish a long rest, if the homunculus is on the same plane as you, you can choose to spend up to half your Hit Dice. Roll each die and add your Constitution modifier to each roll. Your hit point maximum is reduced by the total, and the homunculus's hit point maximum and current hit points both increase by that amount. This process cannot reduce your hit points below 1. These changes to your and the homunculus's hit points are reversed when you finish your next long rest. Until then, your hit point maximum reduction cannot be removed unless the homunculus dies.
• You can have only one homunculus at a time. If you cast the spell while your homunculus is still alive, the spell fails.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-005 59e4709fed3fce76e77dcb29 (2014 M411); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 56b3d71950f35a1e038ec6f15f5432cb9d7dc9e86e797202df931869bc6c605a. Parent contextual note: All damage, same-plane long-rest/Hit Dice transfer, per-die Constitution modifier, different caster maximum versus homunculus current-and-maximum changes, restoration/death exception and singleton failure are retained. The source's minimum-1 sentence says hit points without explicitly repeating maximum; that distinction is not silently rewritten.

source:
• 你呼唤自然之灵来守护一块户外区域或者是地底。这片区域最小为边长30尺的立方体，最大则可达边长90尺的立方体。建筑物和其他构造物会被排除在受影响区域外。如果你在一年内每天对同一区域施展该法术，法术将持续到被解除。
• 法术将在区域内产生如下效果。当你施展该法术时，你可以指定生物作为友伴免疫这些效果。你也可以指定一个口令，大声说出口令的人也同样免疫这些效果。
• 整个被保护的区域都辐射着魔法。一道在区域内施展的解除魔法法术若成功，将只移除以下效果之一，而非整块区域。法术的施法者可以选择一个效果结束。只有当所有效果结束时法术才会被解除。
• 重雾Solid Fog：你可以在地面上分布厚雾填充任意数量的5尺方格，使其处于重度隐蔽之下。雾气高达10尺。在穿过雾气时每移动1尺就要花费额外2尺的移动力。在免疫这个效果的生物眼中，雾气什么也不会掩盖，并且看起来像是漂浮在空气中的绿色光点。
• 纠缠灌木Grasping Undergrowth：你可以在没有被填充雾气的地面上分布纠缠的藤蔓和杂草填充任意数量的5尺方格，如同它们受到了纠缠术Entangle的影响。对免疫这个效果的生物而言这些野草和藤蔓都是柔软的，甚至可以重塑形态成为临时的座椅和床铺。
• 林地守卫Grove Guardians：你可以活化区域内最多四棵树木，使它们从地面上拔根而起。这些树木与怪物手册中的启蒙树Awakened tree有相同的数据，除了它们不会说话，并且在它们的表皮上覆盖着德鲁伊符记。如果有任何不免疫这个效果的生物进入被保护的区域，林地守卫会与它们战斗直到入侵者被赶走或被杀死。林地守卫也遵从你在这个区域内发布的口头命令（无需你的动作）。如果你没有给它们命令也没有入侵者，林地守卫不会行动。林地守卫不能从被保护的区域离开。在法术结束时，驱动它们的魔法也会消失，它们会重新生根（如果可能的话）。
• 额外法术效果Additional Spell Effect：你可以从以下魔法效果中选择其一放置在被保护的区域。
• 在你选择的两个位置布置持续的造风术Gust of Wind效果。
• 在你选择的一个位置布置荆棘丛生Spike Growth效果。
• 在你选择的两个位置布置风墙术Wall of Wind效果。
• 对免疫这个效果的生物而言，风是带着芳香的微风，而布置荆棘丛生的区域是无害的。
context: column:M;spell:Druid Grove;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:6
target:
• You call on spirits of nature to protect an outdoor or underground area. The area is a cube with sides from 30 feet to 90 feet long. Buildings and other structures are excluded. If you cast the spell on the same area every day for a year, it lasts until dispelled.
• The spell produces the following effects in the area. When you cast it, you can designate creatures as friends who are immune to these effects. You can also choose a password; anyone who speaks it aloud is likewise immune.
• The entire warded area radiates magic. A successful Dispel Magic cast within the area removes only one of the following effects, rather than the entire ward. The caster of Dispel Magic chooses which effect to end. Only when all effects have ended is the spell dispelled.
• Solid Fog: You can fill any number of 5-foot squares on the ground with thick fog, heavily obscuring them. The fog is 10 feet high. Each foot of movement through it costs an additional 2 feet of movement. To a creature immune to this effect, the fog obscures nothing and appears as green motes of light floating in the air.
• Grasping Undergrowth: You can fill any number of 5-foot squares of ground not filled with fog with grasping vines and weeds, as though affected by Entangle. To a creature immune to this effect, the plants are soft and can even be reshaped into temporary seats or beds.
• Grove Guardians: You can animate up to four trees in the area, causing them to uproot themselves. They use the Awakened Tree statistics from the Monster Manual, except that they cannot speak and their bark is covered with druidic symbols. If a creature not immune to this effect enters the warded area, the guardians fight it until it is driven off or killed. The guardians also obey verbal commands you give within the area, with no action required from you. Without commands or intruders, they do not act. They cannot leave the warded area. When the spell ends, the magic animating them ends, and they take root again if possible.
• Additional Spell Effect: You can choose one of the following magical effects to place in the warded area.
• Continuous Gust of Wind effects at two locations you choose.
• A Spike Growth effect at one location you choose.
• Wall of Wind effects at two locations you choose.
• To creatures immune to these effects, the winds are fragrant breezes, and the area of Spike Growth is harmless.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-005 7ce6a2451316ee62f0c45ccf (2014 M415); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 b979f183e7da82cdc627005c6169a897c1700a1dbe61353e68c809545919a41c. Parent contextual note: All area, exemptions/password, effect-by-effect dispelling, fog costs, mutually exclusive fog/undergrowth squares, four guardians and three additional-effect choices are retained. The source names Wall of Wind in English and that name is preserved. The dispelling caster is taken as the immediately preceding Dispel Magic caster; no whole-ward removal is substituted.

source:
• 火焰环绕着你的身体，照亮周围30尺半径的区域，并在外围30尺范围内产生微弱的亮光。这些火焰不会伤害到你。直到此法术终结，你得到如下的增益：
• 你免疫火焰伤害并对冷冻伤害具有抗性。
• 任何在回合中第一次进入你周围5尺范围之内，或是在你周围5尺范围之内结束回合的生物受到1d10点火焰伤害。
• 你可以使用你的动作以创造出一条以你为起始点，向由你选择的方向延伸的15尺长、5尺宽的火线。在线中的每个生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免检定。豁免失败的生物受到4d8点火焰伤害，豁免成功者受到上述伤害的一半。
context: column:M;spell:Investiture of Flame;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:6
target:
• Flames surround your body, illuminating a 30-foot radius and shedding dim light for an additional 30 feet. These flames do not harm you. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:
• You are immune to fire damage and have resistance to cold damage.
• A creature that enters within 5 feet of you for the first time on a turn or ends its turn within 5 feet of you takes 1d10 fire damage.
• You can use your action to create a line of fire originating from you, 15 feet long and 5 feet wide, extending in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-005 41d9ba7b0db20d7ed90f9ff6 (2014 M426); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 efb86f397ebe7d1106c47ee1c60d02218d40cabb0ab942e523fe303caf0ba580. Parent contextual note: All three benefits, the harmless personal flames and two illumination ranges are retained. The proximity trigger is first entry or end of turn, not start of turn.

source:
• 直到此法术终结，寒冰浸沐了你的躯体，你得到如下增益：
• 你免疫冷冻伤害，并对火焰伤害具有抗性。
• 你可以在由冰或雪形成的困难地形上移动而无需额外消耗移动力。
• 以你为中心，周围10尺半径的区域被冻结了，对于你之外的生物而言，其被视为困难地形。此范围会随着你移动而移动。
• 你可以使用你的动作以创造出一道15尺的寒风锥，以你张开的手为起始点，向由你选择的任意方向延伸。在锥内的每个生物均必须进行一次体质豁免检定。检定失败则受到4d6点冷冻伤害，若成功则受到上述伤害的一半。在对抗该效应的豁免检定中失败的生物，直到你的下个回合开始，其速度减半。
context: column:M;spell:Investiture of Ice;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:6
target:
• Until the spell ends, ice bathes your body and you gain the following benefits:
• You are immune to cold damage and have resistance to fire damage.
• Moving through difficult terrain made of ice or snow costs you no extra movement.
• The area in a 10-foot radius around you is frozen and is difficult terrain for creatures other than you. This area moves with you.
• You can use your action to create a 15-foot cone of freezing wind originating from your open hand and extending in any direction you choose. Each creature in the cone must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 4d6 cold damage and its speed is halved until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-005 4da0603c4248495d0bea91d6 (2014 M427); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 e4ad26b45fb6faf34334bd9a80f3481138bdc358e1ff8c8c985b731af21825f0. Parent contextual note: All four benefits are retained. The cone's speed reduction is explicitly grouped with failed-save damage, while a successful save gives half damage only; its expiry is the start of the caster's next turn.

source:
• 直到法术终结，岩石颗粒布满了你的躯体，你得到如下增益：
• 你对于来自非魔法攻击的钝击，穿刺和挥砍伤害得到抗性。
• 你可以以一个动作，在以你为中心周围15尺半径的地表创造出一阵小型地震。在地表上的其他生物必须通过一次敏捷豁免检定，否则会摔倒。
• 你可以在由泥土或岩石造成的困难地形上移动而无需额外消耗移动力。你可以穿过固态的泥土或石头，像是穿过空气那样。这并未令穿过的物质变得不再凝固，但你不能在物质中结束你的移动。若你结束了移动，你将被排出到最近的未被占据的空间内，此法术终结，你在直到你下个回合结束前的时间内陷入震慑状态。
context: column:M;spell:Investiture of Stone;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:6
target:
• Until the spell ends, rocky grains cover your body and you gain the following benefits:
• You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
• As an action, you can create a small earthquake in the ground within a 15-foot radius centered on you. Other creatures on that ground must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.
• Moving through difficult terrain made of earth or rock costs you no extra movement. You can pass through solid earth or stone as if it were air. This does not make the material any less solid, but you cannot end your movement inside it. If you do end your movement inside, you are ejected into the nearest unoccupied space, the spell ends, and you are stunned until the end of your next turn.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-005 6a1a7cbd0af7528549adfb17 (2014 M428); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 0f98630f80913a76d500166aab3dc10dbb84e3381a0dccbe737daa4e2c18c7a1. Parent contextual note: All three benefits and the nonmagical-attack restriction are retained. The source's shortened if-you-end-movement clause is understood in its immediately preceding context of ending inside solid matter; ejection, spell termination and stun duration are all preserved.

source:
• 直到此法术终止，风在你的身旁回旋，而你得到下述增益：
• 对你进行的远程武器攻击，在其攻击检定中具有劣势。
• 你得到60尺的飞行速度。若此法术终止时，你仍处于飞行状态，你会坠落，除非你有其他方法避免坠落。
• 你可以使用你的动作以在你60尺范围内，以你能看到的一点为中心，制造出15立方尺的呼啸之风。每个在该空间内的生物必须进行一次体质豁免检定。豁免失败的生物受到2d10点钝击伤害，豁免成功者受到上述伤害的一半。若体型不超过大型的生物在此豁免中失败。该生物将在远离该空间中心的方向上被推离10尺。
context: column:M;spell:Investiture of Wind;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:6
target:
• Until the spell ends, wind swirls around you and you gain the following benefits:
• Ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage on their attack rolls.
• You gain a flying speed of 60 feet. If you are still flying when the spell ends, you fall unless you have another way to prevent the fall.
• You can use your action to create 15 cubic feet of howling wind centered on a point you can see within 60 feet of you. Each creature in that space must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. A Large or smaller creature that fails this save is also pushed 10 feet away from the space's center.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-005 9b5cede67969ba06f1f046ad (2014 M429); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 86d44c5e7e8681bbfa166b581d4f34c43e0b6efd0772d1db3b4dc19bd8fda83d. Flight-ending fall, ranged-weapon-only disadvantage and failed-save/Large-or-smaller push are preserved; the broken final sentence is joined without broadening its condition.

source:
• 你试图将目标生物束缚在一个只有他自己能感知的幻觉牢房中。在距离内你选择的一个可见的生物必须进行一次智力豁免检定。如果目标免疫魅惑，它在这次豁免中自动成功。若豁免成功，目标受到5d10心灵伤害，同时法术结束。若豁免失败，在造成5d10心灵伤害的同时你立即创造出环绕目标所在空间的某种危险区域。你也许会让目标感觉到自己被烈火、被浮动的刀锋、被可怕的獠牙所包围。
• 无论你采用什么形式的幻象，目标都不能越过它看到或听到任何事物，并且在法术持续时间内被束缚。如果目标移动出幻象，穿过它进行一次近战攻击检定，或尝试用身体的任何部分穿过它，目标受到10d10心灵伤害，然后法术结束。
context: column:M;spell:Mental Prison;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:6
target:
• You attempt to bind a creature in an illusory prison that only it can perceive. One creature you choose that you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. If the target is immune to being charmed, it automatically succeeds. On a success, it takes 5d10 Psychic damage and the spell ends. On a failure, it takes 5d10 Psychic damage, and you immediately create the illusion of a dangerous area surrounding its space. You might make it believe it is surrounded by flames, floating blades, or terrifying fangs.
• Whatever form the illusion takes, the target cannot see or hear anything beyond it and is restrained for the duration. If the target moves out of the illusion, makes a melee attack roll through it, or tries to pass any part of its body through it, it takes 10d10 Psychic damage, and the spell ends.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-006 037cb478be15a5dbb7b7a17b (2014 M432); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 88dc79515f88687af036cd6a4dfbaf64617907a9abe0f1fb68e9169f07e24d37. Parent contextual note: Automatic success from charm immunity, damage on both initial save outcomes and all three separate prison-breaking triggers are preserved.

source: • 你选择距离之内最多5个可见生物，震颤的空气将环绕他们周围。一个非自愿的生物必须成功进行感知豁免检定来抵抗该法术。你将每个受影响的生物传送至120尺内任意你可以看见且未被占据的空间。这个空间必须在地面上或在地板上。
target: • Shimmering air surrounds up to 5 creatures you choose that you can see within range. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist the spell. You teleport each affected creature to any unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet. The space must be on the ground or on a floor.

source:
• 该法术攫取一个死去的类人生物的灵魂，并将它关在你用作为法术材料成分的笼子里。被偷窃而来的灵魂在笼子里持续到法术结束或者你摧毁这个笼子，这也会使法术结束。当你的笼子里面有一个灵魂时，你可以用下文描述的任一方法来利用它。一个被困住的灵魂最多被你这样使用6次。一旦你第六次利用这个灵魂，它将会被释放，然后法术结束。在灵魂被困住时，作为灵魂来源的已死类人生物无法被复活。
• 窃取生命Steal Life：你可以用一个附赠动作从灵魂中吸取活力并恢复2d8生命值。
• 灵魂质问Query Soul：你向灵魂提出一个问题（无需动作）并得到一个简短的回答作为心灵感应，无论用什么语言你都可以理解。灵魂只知道它的人生中了解的事物，但它必须如实回答并且尽其所能。回答至多是一两句话，也有可能是有隐藏意义的。
• 借鉴经验Borrow Experience：你可以使用一个附赠动作让灵魂的人生经验来支撑你，令你的下一次攻击检定，能力检定和豁免检定具有优势。如果在你的下个回合开始之前你没有使用这个增益，它将会消失。
• 亡者之眼Eyes of the Dead：你可以使用一个动作来说出这个类人生物在人生中曾见过的地点的名字，如果你和那个地点在同一位面，你可以在那里创造出一个隐形的传感器。这个传感器将维持到你的专注结束，最多10分钟（如同你正专注于一个法术）。你从这个传感器中接受视觉和听觉信息，就如同你在那个地点使用自己的感官。
• 能看到这个传感器的生物（例如使用了识破隐形See Invisibility法术或是拥有真实视觉）将会看到被你关在笼中的受难者半透明的影像。
context: column:M;spell:Soul Cage;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:6
target:
• This spell snatches a dead Humanoid's soul and traps it in the cage used as the spell's material component. The stolen soul remains in the cage until the spell ends or you destroy the cage, which also ends the spell. While a soul is in your cage, you can exploit it in any of the ways below. You can exploit a trapped soul up to 6 times. The sixth use releases it and ends the spell. While its soul is trapped, the dead Humanoid cannot be revived.
• Steal Life: You can take a Bonus Action to draw vitality from the soul and regain 2d8 Hit Points.
• Query Soul: You ask the soul a question, requiring no action, and receive a brief telepathic answer that you understand regardless of its language. The soul knows only what it knew in life, but it must answer truthfully and to the best of its ability. The answer is no more than one or two sentences and might be cryptic.
• Borrow Experience: You can take a Bonus Action to draw on the soul's life experience, giving you Advantage on your next attack roll, ability check, and saving throw. This benefit disappears if you have not used it before the start of your next turn.
• Eyes of the Dead: You can take an action to name a place the Humanoid saw during its life. If you are on the same plane as that place, you create an invisible sensor there. The sensor lasts while you maintain concentration, up to 10 minutes, as though concentrating on a spell. You see and hear through it as though you were in that place using your own senses.
• A creature that can see the sensor, such as one using See Invisibility or possessing Truesight, sees a translucent image of the suffering soul you have trapped in the cage.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-006 4b25d482aad44fdbf5d1fb59 (2014 M440); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 ebb8ac69dcbbecfb85ed4356dedc042049e23afd793c1cdb25c796372bca6d96. Parent contextual note: All four exploitation choices, six-use release, blocked revival, next-turn expiry and sensor concentration/appearance are complete; no extra action cost is added to Query Soul. Borrow Experience lists the next attack roll, ability check and saving throw together in the source; the conjunction is retained rather than adding a single-roll consumption rule.

source:
• 你创造一道闪着银光的力场，环绕在施法距离内你所选择的一个生物周围（你可以选择你自己）。该力场散发5尺微光光照。被力场保护的生物获得以下增益：
→掩护：该生物具有半身掩护。
→伤害抗性：该生物获得对强酸，冷冻，火焰，闪电以及毒素伤害的抗性。
→反射闪避：如果该生物受到可以由成功通过敏捷豁免来使伤害减半的效应影响，该生物在成功通过豁免时改为不受任何伤害，失败则受到一半伤害。
• 在之后的回合内，你可以以一个附赠动作将该力场移动至力场周围60尺内的另一个生物身上。
context: column:M;spell:Fizban's Platinum Shield;book:费茨本的巨龙宝库;level:6
target:
• You create a silvery, shimmering field of force around one creature you choose within range, which can be yourself. The field sheds Dim Light for 5 feet. The protected creature gains these benefits:
→ Cover: The creature has Half Cover.
→ Damage Resistance: The creature has Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, and Poison damage.
→ Evasion: If an effect allows the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, the creature instead takes no damage on a successful save and half damage on a failed save.
• On subsequent turns, you can take a Bonus Action to move the field to another creature within 60 feet of the field.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-006 ea1c813b1209e3ddd7cc2d2d (2014 M451); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 e2d5e6169aeb3b365a86c0a02d0c45443e748d1f547e04d2eb4b059f08fa7c7c. Parent contextual note: The transfer distance is measured from the field in this source, not silently changed to the caster. All three protection benefits and the light radius remain.

source:
• 你以自身为原点咒现出一条长100尺，宽5尺的重力能量。所有在线上的生物需要进行一个体质豁免，若失败，则受到8d8点力场伤害，若豁免成功则受到一半伤害。
• 所有距离这条线10尺或以内但不在线当中的生物需要通过一个体质豁免，若失败则受到8d8点力场伤害并且会被拉向线的区域中。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用7环或更高环位的法术位施展该法术时，每比6环高出一环的法术位能使该法术的伤害增加1d8。
target:
• You conjure a line of gravitational energy originating from you, 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature on the line must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 force damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
• Each creature within 10 feet of the line but not on it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 8d8 force damage and be pulled into the line's area.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 7 or higher spell slot, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 6.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-005 1cfedf0aec4a322874757211 (2014 M421); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 8eb3dd1b322b2a43eeeb4f7011035f0f76b5b0b3a01bb9b4a61617a608b919cc. Parent contextual note: The line and nearby-off-line branches remain distinct: only the line branch states half damage on success, and the off-line damage/pull both require failure. Dimensions and scaling are retained.

source: 你将手举过头顶，咒唤蕴含着庞大力量，对周围一切充满敌意的可怖赤印。持续时间内，在你每个回合结束时，位于你30尺内的每个生物（包括你自己）都会受到5d8的暗蚀伤害，此伤害不会终止你的专注。若一个生物的生命值因此降至0，则他连同其穿着和携带的非魔法物品一起化为一滩粘液和内脏。因此而死的生物只能通过完全复生术True Resurrection或祈愿术Wish 复活。
context: column:M;spell:Red Sign;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:6
target: You raise your hand above your head and conjure a horrific red sign that holds immense power and is hostile to everything around it. For the duration, at the end of each of your turns, every creature within 30 feet of you, including you, takes 5d8 Necrotic damage. This damage doesn't end your Concentration. If a creature's Hit Points drop to 0 from this damage, it and the nonmagical items it wears and carries turn into a puddle of slime and entrails. A creature killed this way can be restored to life only by True Resurrection or Wish.
note: Keeps self-inclusion, end-of-your-turn trigger, the damage-specific Concentration exception, carried nonmagical item destruction, and the two resurrection methods.

source:
你在施法范围内指定你能看到的一点，用辛辣的粘液泼洒出一片半径20尺的立方区域，粘液会在法术持续时间内始终存在。该区域将成为困难地形，且任何处于该区域内的生物都将陷入目盲状态，且无法使用反应。
一个在该区域内开始其回合的生物必须通过一次体质豁免，否则将承受2d8点毒素伤害和2d8点强酸伤害，并积累一层力竭。
升环施法效应：使用七环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比六环高一环，法术就额外造成1d8点强酸伤害和1d8点毒素伤害。
target:
You choose a point you can see within range and splash pungent slime into a cubic area with a radius of 20 feet. The slime remains for the duration. The area becomes Difficult Terrain, and any creature in it has the Blinded condition and can't take Reactions.
A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 2d8 Poison damage and 2d8 Acid damage and gain one level of Exhaustion.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast the spell with a level-seven or higher slot, it deals an extra 1d8 Acid damage and 1d8 Poison damage for each slot level above level six.
note: The original describes a cubic area with a radius of 20 feet, a geometrically inconsistent expression. It is translated literally without choosing a cube edge or sphere. All start-turn damage and Exhaustion failure conditions are retained.

source:
你用手指指向范围内的一个生物，向其投射出一道苍绿色的削弱能量。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中则目标需承受12d6点黯蚀伤害，并变得虚弱。
当目标因此法术变得虚弱时，其武器攻击和法术只能造成一半的伤害。
被此法术削弱的生物可以在其每个回合结束时进行一次体质豁免，若豁免检定成功则虚弱状态终止。
target:
You point a finger at a creature within range and project a ray of pale green, weakening energy at it. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 12d6 Necrotic damage and becomes weakened.
While weakened by this spell, the target deals only half damage with its weapon attacks and spells.
A creature weakened by this spell can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the weakening on a successful save.
note: Weakened is treated as the effect described in this cell, without substituting an unrelated condition. The hit requirement, damage halving scope, and optional end-turn save are preserved.

source: 40尺的光环以你为中心展开，干扰所有飞弹projectile并使所有远程武器故障。处于光环内，任何远程武器被用于攻击时都会故障，该次攻击被浪费lost。武器故障后将无法被使用，直至有生物用利用动作将武器的故障修理完毕为止。任何武器发动的攻击中，若其飞弹会穿过光环区域，本次攻击就将具有劣势，命中后造成的伤害也将减半。
context: column:M;spell:Antiballistic Field;book:瓦尔达的秘密尖塔;level:6
target: A 40-foot Emanation extends from you, disrupting all projectiles and causing ranged weapons to malfunction. Any ranged weapon used to attack inside the Emanation malfunctions, and the attack is lost. A malfunctioning weapon can't be used until a creature takes a Utilize action to repair it. Any weapon attack whose projectile passes through the Emanation has Disadvantage and deals half damage on a hit.
note: Preserves the distinct malfunction/lost-attack rule inside the aura and Disadvantage/half-damage rule for projectiles passing through it. It is not broadened to all ranged spell attacks.

source:
你魔法性地强制施法距离内一个能听见并能理解你的生物参与一场有着至关重要影响的非魔法游戏。非自愿的生物必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则被迫加入游戏。
游戏的输家会受到6d6心灵伤害。如果在法术持续时间结束时无人胜出，则你与目标均受到此伤害。如果你或你的盟友伤害了目标，你将自动认输，反之亦然，如果目标或其盟友伤害你。此外，你和目标生物可以协商更大的赌注。你可以押注更高的心灵伤害（最高12d6），货币，财产，或更抽象的奖励，例如授予贵族头衔。法术会揭示一个生物是否试图押注其无法兑现的赌注。下注会在你与目标最终同意并以握手或类似动作确认后生效。游戏中赌上的财产或货币会在游戏结束时传送到赢家。输家还会被魔法性地强制执行押注时承诺的任何行动（例如授予贵族头衔）。
最后，除你和目标以外，没有任何法术、魔法效应或生物能影响游戏结果。
context: column:M;spell:Game of Fate;book:瓦尔达的秘密尖塔;level:6
target:
You magically compel a creature within range that can hear and understand you to participate in a nonmagical game with momentous stakes. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw and is forced to join the game on a failed save.
The loser takes 6d6 Psychic damage. If no one has won when the spell's duration ends, both you and the target take this damage. If you or your allies harm the target, you automatically forfeit; conversely, the target forfeits if it or its allies harm you. You and the target can also negotiate greater stakes. You can wager more Psychic damage, up to 12d6, money, property, or more abstract rewards, such as granting a noble title. The spell reveals whether a creature tries to offer a stake it can't deliver. The wager takes effect once you and the target reach a final agreement and confirm it with a handshake or similar gesture. Money or property wagered on the game teleports to the winner when the game ends. The loser is also magically compelled to perform any actions promised in the wager, such as granting a noble title.
Finally, no spell, magical effect, or creature other than you and the target can influence the game's outcome.
note: All wager, tie-at-expiry, harm/forfeit, agreement, impossible-stake disclosure, transfer, compelled-action, and outside-influence clauses are retained. The final broad exclusion is kept as written without resolving its interaction with participant magic.

source:
你在身体周围创造出一个巨大的虚体甲壳，它能保护你并在战斗中助你一臂之力。在持续时间内，你的护甲等级变为20（若原本不高于此值），获得40尺游泳速度，以及30尺范围内的盲视。此外，你可以使用附赠动作用你的钳子进行一次近战武器攻击。此攻击使用你的法术攻击加值，命中时造成1d10点钝击伤害。
另外，你的虚体甲壳拥有15点的伤害阈值。伤害阈值使你免疫所有未达到阈值的伤害，只有等于或大于阈值的伤害才能正常对你造成伤害。任何未达到甲壳伤害阈值的伤害都被视为浅层伤害，不会减少任何生命值。
target:
You create an enormous spectral carapace around your body that protects you and aids you in combat. For the duration, your Armor Class becomes 20 unless it is already higher, you gain a Swim Speed of 40 feet, and you gain Blindsight within 30 feet. In addition, you can take a Bonus Action to make one melee weapon attack with your claw. This attack uses your spell attack modifier and deals 1d10 Bludgeoning damage on a hit.
Your spectral carapace also has a damage threshold of 15. This threshold makes you immune to any damage below it; only damage equal to or greater than the threshold damages you normally. Damage below the carapace's threshold is treated as superficial and doesn't reduce any Hit Points.
note: Preserves the AC floor, exact threshold comparator (equal damage still applies), senses, speed, and melee weapon attack using spell attack modifier. No subtraction of 15 from qualifying damage is introduced.

source:
你唤起众多已逝骑士之精魂，从你所在之处向前冲锋，形成一条90尺长、20尺宽的线状区域，随后消失。该线状区域内每个你选择的生物都必须进行一次感知豁免。若豁免失败，则目标受到5d12暗蚀伤害，陷入恐慌状态，直至你的下一回合开始，并且其必须立即使用反应（若可用），以最安全的路线尽可能远离你。若豁免成功，则该生物仅受到一半伤害。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比六环高一环，伤害就增加1d12。
target:
You call forth the spirits of many fallen knights, who charge forward from your position in a Line 90 feet long and 20 feet wide, then disappear. Each creature of your choice in the Line must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 5d12 Necrotic damage, has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn, and must immediately use its Reaction, if available, to move as far away from you as possible by the safest route. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above level six.
note: The failure branch retains damage, exact Frightened endpoint, and immediate available-Reaction movement by safest route; success grants only half damage.

source:
你召唤一个挑战等级为7或更低的巨人生物，出现在施法距离内一处可见的未占据空间。当他们的生命值降至0或法术结束时，巨人就会消失。巨人对你和你的同伴友好。巨人需投掷先攻，它有自己的回合，服从你的任何口头命令（不需要你的任何动作），只要这些命令不违背其阵营。如果你不发出任何命令，它会保护自己免受敌对生物的攻击，否则不会采取任何动作。
如果你的专注被打破，巨人不会消失。相反，你失去了对巨人的控制，它变得对你和你的同伴充满敌意，可能会攻击你。不受控制的巨人不能被你解散，它在召唤后1小时消失。巨人的具体数值由DM掌握。
升环施法。当你用七环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比六环高一环，可召唤的最高巨人挑战等级加1。
target:
You summon a Giant creature with a Challenge Rating of 7 or lower in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The Giant disappears when its Hit Points drop to 0 or the spell ends. It is friendly to you and your companions. The Giant rolls Initiative and takes its own turns. It obeys your verbal commands, which require no action from you, as long as they don't conflict with its alignment. If you give no commands, it defends itself against hostile creatures but otherwise takes no actions.
If your Concentration is broken, the Giant doesn't disappear. Instead, you lose control of it, and it becomes hostile to you and your companions and might attack you. You can't dismiss an uncontrolled Giant, and it disappears 1 hour after it was summoned. The DM has the Giant's statistics.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell with a level-seven or higher slot, the maximum Challenge Rating of the Giant you can summon increases by 1 for each slot level above level six.
note: The source's alignment-limited obedience, independent Initiative, no-command behavior, hostile loss-of-Concentration exception, one-hour timing from summoning, and higher CR progression are all retained.

source:
当施展该法术时，你和你选择的施法距离内的三名生物必须通过一次体质豁免，并且在该法术生效时，在其每个回合开始时再进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败的生物会被束缚。若三个目标生物之一未能通过此豁免，且另两个初始目标若在豁免失败者30尺内也需再次进行豁免。一个被束缚的目标需在其每个回合继续重复豁免，每次豁免失败都会令其情况恶化： 受影响的回合数 状态 
1（即施法回合） 束缚 
2 失能 
3 震慑 
4 麻痹 
5 石化（变成石头） 

每次豁免失败，就会恶化先前的情况。新的豁免成功时，受影响目标的状况的严重程度降低一级。如果除你以外的目标在被束缚时豁免成功，则对该目标的法术结束。（你必须每轮进行一次豁免。） 
与所有专注法术一样，你可以随时结束该法术（无需任何动作）。如果你被变成石头，则该法术在所有受影响的生物进行豁免后结束。生物在法术结束后立即恢复，但变成石头的生物除外，它们会一直保持这种状态，直到效果被移除。 
变成石头的生物可以正常地看、听和闻，但它们不需要吃东西或呼吸。如果对石化生物施放粉碎音波Shatter，该生物必须通过一次体质豁免对抗施法者的法术豁免DC，否则将被杀死。 
变成石头的生物可以用解除魔法Dispel Magic、高等复原术Greater Restoration或类似的魔法恢复 。
context: column:M;spell:Doom of Stacked Stones;book:黯潮之书;level:6
target:
When you cast this spell, you and three creatures of your choice within range must make a Constitution saving throw, and each must make another Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns while the spell is in effect. A creature that fails the save has the Restrained condition. If one of the three targets fails this save, the other two initial targets must also make another save if they are within 30 feet of the creature that failed. A Restrained target continues to repeat the save each turn, and each failure worsens its condition: Turns affected | Condition
1 (the turn of casting) | Restrained
2 | Incapacitated
3 | Stunned
4 | Paralyzed
5 | Petrified (turned to stone)

Each failed save worsens the preceding condition. A successful new save reduces the affected target's condition by one step. If a target other than you succeeds on a save while Restrained, the spell ends for that target. You must make one save each round.
As with all Concentration spells, you can end this spell at any time, requiring no action. If you turn to stone, the spell ends after all affected creatures have made their saves. Creatures recover immediately when the spell ends, except those turned to stone, who remain so until the effect is removed.
Creatures turned to stone can see, hear, and smell normally, but don't need to eat or breathe. If Shatter is cast on a Petrified creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or be killed.
A creature turned to stone can be restored with Dispel Magic, Greater Restoration, or similar magic.
note: The full five-row progression table and every recovery/death clause are retained. The source distinguishes you from the three selected targets, including chain-trigger saves only for the other two original targets; its repeated-save timing and stated turn-based table are not reconciled into a different mechanic.

source:
你能从垂死的生物身上获取生命力，并用它来增强你施放的下一个法术。你的目标必须生命值为0且濒死，或必须在上一轮中死亡。如果目标濒死，则必须通过一次体质豁免，否则死亡。你下一次施法时，你获得1d10+你的施法属性调整值点临时生命值。你还可以选择以下效果之一，受该法术影响的目标会受到额外效果。如果你在施展该法术后1分钟内没有施放其他法术，该效果就会消失。
笨拙Clumsiness。目标的速度减半，持续1分钟，并在敏捷属性检定和豁免上具有劣势。 在其每个回合结束时，它可以进行一次体质豁免。如果成功，则效果结束。
疲劳Fatiguing。目标必须进行一次体质豁免，若豁免失败则会获得1d4层力竭，若成功则会获得1层力竭。
吸血Vampiric。你恢复相当于你所造成伤害量一半的生命值。如果你对多个生物造成伤害，你将恢复对其中一个目标造成的伤害的一半的生命值。
软弱Weakness。目标近战攻击命中时造成的伤害取最小值，持续1分钟。 在其每个回合结束时，它可以进行一次体质豁免。 如果成功，则效果结束。
凋零Withering。你额外造成4伤害骰的伤害，伤害骰类型与该法术的伤害骰类型一致，且你的法术造成的所有伤害均变为暗蚀伤害。
target:
You draw life force from a dying creature and use it to enhance the next spell you cast. Your target must have 0 Hit Points and be dying, or must have died during the previous round. If the target is dying, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or die. The next time you cast a spell, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your spellcasting ability modifier. You can also choose one of the effects below, which applies an additional effect to targets affected by that spell. If you don't cast another spell within 1 minute after casting this spell, the effect fades.
Clumsiness. The target's Speed is halved for 1 minute, and it has Disadvantage on Dexterity ability checks and saving throws. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
Fatiguing. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it gains 1d4 levels of Exhaustion; on a successful save, it gains 1 level.
Vampiric. You regain Hit Points equal to half the damage you deal. If you damage multiple creatures, you regain Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt to one of them.
Weakness. The target's melee attacks deal their minimum damage on a hit for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
Withering. You deal an extra 4 damage dice of the same die type as the spell's damage dice, and all damage dealt by your spell becomes Necrotic damage.
note: All five named enhancements are complete. The source 0-HP/dying-or-previous-round-death eligibility, first victim save, next-spell Temporary HP, optional enhancement choice, one-minute expiry, and Fatiguing success still causing Exhaustion are retained. It does not state how Withering chooses among mixed damage dice, so no rule is added.

source:
致死的伟力在持续时间内覆盖源自你的60尺光环区域。
你在施展该法术时可以指定哪些生物不受其影响。任何其余的生物在位于光环内期间都无法恢复生命值。当光环进入一名生物的占据空间，或是一名生物进入光环或是在光环之中结束自己的回合时，此生物都要进行一次体质豁免检定。豁免失败则受3d10暗蚀伤害且陷入倒地状态。豁免成功则仅受半伤且速度减半。一名生物一回合只进行一次此豁免。
结阵施法。将该法术被作为结阵法术施展需要至少两名辅施法者参与。此时其持续时间变为专注，至多10分钟。
于对抗此法术的豁免中失败的生物还会再获得1级力竭等级。该生物具有力竭等级期间，其无法通过完成长休恢复失去的生命值或移除其力竭等级。
施展该法术时，每一名辅施法者都必须消耗一枚环阶四环及以上的法术位，否则法术失败。
target:
Deadly power fills a 60-foot Emanation originating from you for the duration.
When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures that are unaffected by it. Any other creature can't regain Hit Points while in the Emanation. When the Emanation enters a creature's space, or a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d10 Necrotic damage and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage and its Speed is halved. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
Circle Casting. Casting this as a circle spell requires at least two secondary casters. Its duration then becomes Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
A creature that fails its save against the spell also gains 1 level of Exhaustion. While that creature has levels of Exhaustion, it can't regain lost Hit Points or remove its levels of Exhaustion by completing a Long Rest.
When the spell is cast, each secondary caster must expend a level-four or higher spell slot, or the spell fails.
note: The circle-casting heading and following paragraphs remain in source order, preserving their scope. Failure causes Prone; success causes half damage and halved Speed. No duration for that Speed reduction is invented. Two secondary casters and each one's slot requirement are both retained.

source:
六枚颜色各异的彩色光球在持续时间内围绕着你旋转。
在这些光球存在期间，你可以消耗一枚光球制造以下一种效应：
吸收能量Absorb Energy。当你受到强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电或雷鸣伤害时，你可以执行一个反应并消耗其中一枚光球，令你获得对触发此反应的那种伤害的抗性，直至你的下一回合开始。
光能爆Energy Blast。以一个附赠动作，你可以令一枚光球飞向位于你120尺内的一个目标。发动一次远程法术攻击。若命中，则目标受到3d6点强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电或雷鸣伤害（由你选择）。无论这次攻击命中与否，这枚光球都会被消耗。
此法术会在你消耗完所有光球后提前结束。
升环施法。你使用的法术位每比六环高一环，创造的光球就多一颗。
context: column:M;spell:Elminster's Effulgent Spheres;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:6
target:
Six differently colored spheres of light orbit you for the duration.
While these spheres remain, you can expend one to create one of the following effects:
Absorb Energy. When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, you can take a Reaction and expend one sphere to gain Resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn.
Energy Blast. As a Bonus Action, you can send a sphere flying toward a target within 120 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, your choice. The sphere is expended whether the attack hits or misses.
The spell ends early when you expend all the spheres.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: You create one additional sphere for each slot level above level six.
note: Both five-type lists, Reaction resistance endpoint, Bonus Action attack/range, hit-or-miss expenditure, and sphere count/upcasting are retained.

source:
你将来自上层位面的精魂咒唤，精魂表现为照耀以施法距离内一点为中心半径10尺、高40尺的柱状区域的光之立柱。对位于柱状区域内的你可见的生物，分别选择下列哪种光芒照耀于它。
　　• 治愈之光Healing Light。目标恢复等于 4d12+你的施法属性调整值 点的生命值。
　　• 惩戒之光Searing Light。目标进行一次敏捷豁免检定，豁免失败者将受到6d12的光耀伤害，豁免成功则只受一半伤害。
直到法术结束为止，柱状区域内处于明亮光照，并且当你在你的回合移动时，你可以令柱状区域也移动至多30尺
每当柱状区域在移动中进入了一名你可见的生物区域内时、一名你可见的生物进入柱状区域或是在该区域结束其回合时，你都可以令该生物沐浴其中一种光芒。一名生物一回合只能被该法术影响一次。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比七环高一环，法术产生的治疗和造成的伤害就增加1d12。
target:
You conjure a spirit from the Upper Planes, manifesting as a pillar of light that illuminates a Cylinder with a radius of 10 feet and a height of 40 feet centered on a point within range. For each creature you can see in the Cylinder, choose which of the following lights shines on it.
• Healing Light. The target regains Hit Points equal to 4d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
• Searing Light. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d12 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Until the spell ends, the Cylinder is filled with Bright Light, and when you move on your turn, you can also move the Cylinder up to 30 feet.
Whenever the moving Cylinder enters the space of a creature you can see, or a creature you can see enters the Cylinder or ends its turn there, you can bathe that creature in one of the lights. A creature can be affected by this spell only once per turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The healing and damage increase by 1d12 for each slot level above level seven.
note: Preserves both light choices, all three later triggers with visible-creature restriction, optional later application, movement on your turn, and once-per-turn creature limit.

source:
一束黄光从你的指尖射向施法距离内你指定的一点，并在法术持续时间内在该点凝结成一颗珠子。法术终止时，珠子将伴着低吼炸裂成四窜的烈焰，位于目标点半径20尺球状区域内的每名生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将承受全部累积的火焰伤害，豁免成功则只受到一半伤害。
该法术的基础伤害为12d6，且若在你回合结束时法术尚未终止，则其伤害增加1d6。
如果珠子爆炸前被生物触碰到，则该生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败则法术立即终止并触发爆炸效应。豁免成功则该生物可将珠子抛开至多40尺。当珠子进入一名生物的空间或撞到某个固态物件时，法术立即终止并且触发爆炸效应。
珠子爆炸时，区域内未被着装或携带的可燃物件会开始燃烧。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比七环高一环，基础伤害就提高1d6点。
target:
A beam of yellow light shoots from your fingertip to a point you choose within range and condenses into a bead there for the duration. When the spell ends, the bead explodes with a low roar into spreading flames. Each creature in a Sphere with a radius of 20 feet centered on the point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking all the accumulated Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The spell's base damage is 12d6. If the spell hasn't ended at the end of your turn, its damage increases by 1d6.
If a creature touches the bead before it explodes, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the spell immediately ends and triggers the explosion. On a successful save, the creature can throw the bead up to 40 feet. When the bead enters a creature's space or strikes a solid object, the spell immediately ends and triggers the explosion.
When the bead explodes, flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried begin burning.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The base damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above level seven.
note: Keeps end-of-turn accumulation, touch save outcomes, optional successful throw, both impact triggers, carried-object exclusion, and upcasting of base damage only.

source:
你吟诵一句充盈上层位面Upper Planes力量的箴言。施法距离内所有由你指定的生物都必须进行一次魅力豁免。豁免失败者，若其生命值低于50，则基于其当前生命值承受以下效应，如圣言效应表中所示。无论其生命值如何，失败于豁免的天族生物、元素生物、妖精生物、邪魔生物均会被遣送回其起源位面（若其并不在其起源位面）并且除非通过祈愿术Wish ，否则其在24小时内不能以任何方式返回当前位面。

圣言效应Divine Word Effects 生命值 效应 
0~20 目标死亡。 
21~30 目标陷入目盲、耳聋、震慑状态，持续1小时。 
31~40 目标陷入目盲、耳聋状态，持续10分钟。 
41~50 目标陷入耳聋状态，持续1分钟。
target:
You utter a word imbued with the power of the Upper Planes. Each creature you designate within range must make a Charisma saving throw. A creature that fails and has fewer than 50 Hit Points suffers an effect based on its current Hit Points, as shown in the Divine Word Effects table. Regardless of its Hit Points, a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend that fails its save is sent back to its plane of origin if it isn't already there, and can't return to the current plane by any means other than Wish for 24 hours.

Divine Word Effects | Hit Points | Effect
0–20 | The target dies.
21–30 | The target has the Blinded, Deafened, and Stunned conditions for 1 hour.
31–40 | The target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions for 10 minutes.
41–50 | The target has the Deafened condition for 1 minute.
note: The source opening says fewer than 50 HP while the last table band includes 50. Both are retained rather than silently changing the comparison. All four table bands, four extraplanar creature types, already-home-plane exception, and Wish-only 24-hour return exception remain.

source:
你进入当前所处位面与以太位面Ethereal Plane边缘的重叠空间。你在法术持续时间内一直呆在该以太边界Border Ethereal 。在此期间，你可以向任意方向移动。如果你向上或向下移动，则你移动的每尺距离需要额外消耗一尺的移动力。你可以观察原位面，但是所有事物都以灰度显示，而你也看不到60尺外的东西。
处于以太位面期间，只有同样处在以太位面的其他生物、物件和效应才能被你影响或影响你。不在以太位面的生物无法察觉你，也无法与你互动，除非有一项特性允许他们这么做。
法术终止时，你立刻回到原本所在的位面中与以太边界中你所处位置相对应的空间位置。若你出现于一处被占空间，则你立刻被弹到最靠近的一处未占空间中，并受到两倍于你因此被移动尺数点的力场伤害。
如果你在施展法术时正处于以太位面，或所在位面与以太位面不相连（比如某个外层位面Outer Plane ），则法术立即结束。
升环施法：使用八环施展此法术时，你可以指定至多三名自愿生物（包括你在内）；使用九环时，你可以指定至多六名自愿生物（包括你在内）。所有所选生物在你施法时必须距你10尺内。
target:
You enter the overlapping space between your current plane and the edge of the Ethereal Plane. You remain in this Border Ethereal for the duration. During this time, you can move in any direction. Moving up or down costs an extra foot of movement for each foot traveled. You can observe your original plane, but everything appears in shades of gray, and you can't see beyond 60 feet.
While on the Ethereal Plane, you can affect and be affected only by other creatures, objects, and effects also on that plane. Creatures outside the Ethereal Plane can't perceive or interact with you unless a feature allows them to do so.
When the spell ends, you immediately return to your original plane in the space corresponding to your location in the Border Ethereal. If that space is occupied, you are immediately shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take Force damage equal to twice the number of feet you were moved.
If you are on the Ethereal Plane when you cast the spell, or on a plane that doesn't border it, such as an Outer Plane, the spell immediately ends.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: With a level-eight slot, you can target up to three willing creatures, including yourself. With a level-nine slot, you can target up to six willing creatures, including yourself. All chosen creatures must be within 10 feet of you when you cast the spell.
note: All five paragraphs preserved. Higher-level counts explicitly include the caster; no older-version additional-target progression is substituted. The occupied-space displacement and double-per-foot Force damage are retained.

source:
你向施法距离内的一个可见生物释放负能量。该生物必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败则受到7d8+30点暗蚀伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
被该法术杀死的类人生物将在你下一回合开始时被唤起为一只受你操控的丧尸Zombie（见附录B），并在随后尽力遵循你的口头指令。
target:
You send negative energy at a creature you can see within range. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8 + 30 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
A Humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a Zombie under your control, as described in Appendix B, and thereafter follows your verbal commands to the best of its ability.
note: Preserves Humanoid-only reanimation, start-of-next-turn timing, control, verbal commands, and the original Appendix B reference without supplying external stat data.

source:
一片烈焰风暴出现在施法距离内。风暴的区域由至多十个10尺立方区域组成。你可以自行安排各立方区域的组合方式。每个立方区域必须至少与一个其他的立方区域相连。区域内每个生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到7d10点火焰伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
区域内所有未被着装或携带的可燃物件会开始燃烧。
target:
A storm of flame appears within range. Its area consists of up to ten 10-foot Cubes, which you arrange as you choose. Each Cube must adjoin at least one other Cube. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
All flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried begin burning.
note: The source has no vegetation exemption option, so none is added. Ten connected Cubes, save, damage, and ignition exclusions are complete.

source:
你围绕施法距离内一处指定地点力场构筑出一个固定的立方状隐形Invisible监牢。你可以选择监牢的形式为笼状或盒状。
笼状监牢为各边长至多20尺的立方体，其墙体由1/2寸粗的力场栅栏杆组成，每根杆子之间相距1/2寸。盒状监牢为各边长至多10尺的立方体，其墙体为由力场墙密封，并阻隔一切物质进出，也会阻挡任何从区域中向外界施展或从外界向区域中施展的法术。
施展该法术时，所有完全在法术区域内的生物将被牢笼困住。部分处于区域内或者体型比区域更大的生物则被从区域中心向外推开，直至其完全离开该区域。
牢笼内的生物不能以非魔法的手段离开。如果该生物试图使用传送或跨位面旅行来离开牢笼，则其必须先进行一次魅力豁免。豁免成功则该生物可以用该魔法离开牢笼。豁免失败者将无法以此离开牢笼并浪费掉该法术或效应。该牢笼同时延伸至以太位面Ethereal Plane 从而屏蔽途经以太位面的旅行。
该法术不能被解除魔法Dispel Magic 解除。
target:
You create an immobile, Invisible, cube-shaped prison of force around a point you choose within range. You can choose a cage or a box for the prison's form.
A cage can be up to 20 feet on a side. Its walls consist of force bars 1/2 cun thick, with 1/2 cun between them. A box can be up to 10 feet on a side. Its solid force walls block all matter from passing in or out and block spells cast from inside to outside or from outside to inside.
When you cast the spell, all creatures entirely within the spell's area are trapped. Creatures only partly within the area, or too large to fit inside it, are pushed away from its center until they are completely outside it.
A creature inside can't leave by nonmagical means. If it tries to escape using teleportation or interplanar travel, it must first make a Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, it can use that magic to escape. On a failed save, it can't escape that way and wastes the spell or effect. The prison also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking travel through that plane.
Dispel Magic can't dispel this spell.
note: Both bare source units in 1/2 cun bar thickness/gaps are transliterated, not silently converted to inches. Cage/box dimensions, fully-contained test, displacement, failed-escape expenditure, Ethereal boundary, and Dispel Magic immunity are preserved.

source:
你使至多 1 里方形区域内的地形在视觉、听觉、嗅觉、甚至触觉上都像是某种其它的地形，不过其地形的大致形状仍保持不变。你可以让开阔的平原或者一条路可能变得像一片湿地，一座小山，一个裂谷或是其它困难或无法通行的地形。你还可以让一个池塘变得像一片茂盛的草地，一个悬崖变得像一个缓坡，或者让一个乱石沟变得像一条宽阔平坦的大路。
另外，你还可以改变建筑物的外观，或者在本来没有建筑物的地方添上建筑物。该法术不可以伪装、隐藏或增添生物。
该幻术是听觉、视觉、触觉和嗅觉的综合体，因而其可以把空旷的地面变成困难地形（反之亦然），乃至阻碍区域内的通行。幻象地形的任何一小部分（例如一块石头或者一根树枝）被移动到法术区域外时都会立刻消失不见。
拥有真实视觉的生物可以看穿幻术，洞悉地形的真实形态；然而幻象的所有其它元素仍会得以保留，所以一个意识到这是幻象的生物仍然可以与该幻象进行物理互动。
target:
You make the terrain in an area up to 1 li square look, sound, smell, and even feel like another kind of terrain, while its general shape remains unchanged. You can make an open plain or a road seem to be a swamp, hill, ravine, or other difficult or impassable terrain. You can also make a pond seem to be a lush meadow, a cliff seem to be a gentle slope, or a rocky gully seem to be a broad, smooth road.
You can also alter the appearance of structures or add structures where none exist. The spell can't disguise, hide, or add creatures.
The illusion combines auditory, visual, tactile, and olfactory elements, allowing it to turn open ground into Difficult Terrain or vice versa, or to impede movement through the area. Any small part of the illusory terrain, such as a stone or branch, disappears immediately if moved outside the spell's area.
A creature with Truesight can see through the illusion and discern the terrain's true form. All other elements of the illusion remain, however, so a creature aware of the illusion can still interact with it physically.
note: The bare source li in the square-area extent is retained as li, not converted to miles. All terrain/structure examples, creature prohibition, sensory interactions, removed-fragment disappearance, and Truesight limitation are complete.

source:
你在施法距离内召唤一扇微微发光的门，并维持至法术持续时间结束。门宽5尺，高10尺，指向一个异次元居所。只要该门保持开启，你和你施展该法术时指定的任意生物都可以进入该异次元居所中。你可以在距该门不超过 30 尺处开启或关闭之（无需动作）。门在关闭状态下其无法被发现。
门的另一侧是一个连接着众多房间的华丽大厅。整个居所的空气洁净清新而温暖舒适。
你可以随意创造自己喜欢的房间构造，但不得超出50个相连的边长10尺的立方体。空间内依你喜好配置好家具和装饰，其内储备的食材足以制作供至多100人享用的九菜大宴。由该法术创造的家具和其他物品如果被移出豪宅，就会化作烟雾消散。
一组共100名的近乎透明的仆从会招待任何进入房间的人。仆从的外貌着装由你决定，它们无法受伤并服从你的命令。每个仆从都可以完成一个普通人程度的工作，但它们不能攻击或者进行任何直接伤害其他生物的行动。因而仆从可以完成的工作包括：取来物品、清洁、修理、叠衣服、生火、上菜、倒酒等等。仆从不能离开该居所。
该法术终止时，任何仍处于该异次元空间内的生物或物件都将被移出空间内，并出现在距离入口最近未被占据的空间内。
target:
You conjure a faintly glowing door within range that lasts for the duration. The door is 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall and leads to an extradimensional dwelling. While it is open, you and any creatures you designated when casting the spell can enter the dwelling. You can open or close the door from within 30 feet of it, requiring no action. The closed door can't be detected.
Beyond the door is a splendid hall connected to many rooms. The air throughout the dwelling is clean, fresh, warm, and comfortable.
You can create any room layout you like, within a total of 50 connected 10-foot Cubes. The space is furnished and decorated as you choose and has enough food for a nine-course banquet for up to 100 people. Furnishings and other items created by the spell dissolve into smoke if removed from the mansion.
A group of 100 nearly transparent servants attends to everyone who enters the rooms. You choose their appearance and clothing. They can't be harmed and obey your commands. Each servant can perform the work of an ordinary person, but can't attack or take any action that directly harms another creature. Their tasks can therefore include fetching things, cleaning, repairing, folding clothes, lighting fires, serving food, pouring wine, and so on. The servants can't leave the dwelling.
When the spell ends, any creature or object still in the extradimensional space is moved out into the nearest unoccupied space to the entrance.
note: All five paragraphs are complete, including nine courses, food/servant counts, seven example tasks, departure restrictions, item smoke effect, no-action door operation, and creature/object ejection.

source:
你在施法距离内创造出一个悬浮的灵体剑刃，其在法术持续时间内持续存在。
幽灵剑出现时，你可以对该剑 5 尺内的一个目标进行一次近战法术攻击。命中时，目标受到 4d12+你的施法属性调整值 点力场伤害。 
在你的后续回合内，你能够以一个附赠动作将剑移动至多30尺至一处可见位置。随后你可以对相同或不同目标再次发动该攻击。
target:
You create a hovering spectral blade within range that lasts for the duration.
When the sword appears, you can make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to 4d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
On your subsequent turns, you can take a Bonus Action to move the sword up to 30 feet to a location you can see. You can then repeat the attack against the same or a different target.
note: Retains the source's optional first attack, 5-foot reach, 4d12 plus ability damage, and visible 30-foot Bonus Action movement with repeat attack.

source:
你和至多八名手牵着手形成一个圆圈的自愿生物被输送到一个不同的存在位面。你可以概括地指名一个目的地，比如火元素位面Plane of Fire的黄铜之城City of Brass，或九层地狱Nine Hells第二层迪斯帕特Dispater 的宫殿，按照DM的判断，你将出现在目的地里或其附近。
另外，如果你知道某个处于另一位面的传送法阵的印记序列，则该法术可以把你带到该法阵处。如果该传送法阵太小而装不下所有你输送的生物，则他们会出现在离传送法阵最近的未占据空间中。
target:
You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to another plane of existence. You can name a destination in general terms, such as the City of Brass on the Plane of Fire or Dispater's palace on the second layer of the Nine Hells. You appear in or near that destination, as the DM decides.
Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane, the spell can take you to that circle. If the circle is too small to hold all the creatures you transport, they appear in the nearest unoccupied spaces to it.
note: The source allows you plus up to eight willing creatures; this count is preserved. No unwilling-target attack branch is added. Both destination examples and the sigil-sequence alternative remain.

source:
八条光线从你的手上闪出，作用于60尺锥形范围。每名位于锥形之中的生物进行一次敏捷豁免。为每个目标掷一次1d8来决定影响到它的射线种类，参照虹光射线表。
虹光射线Prismatic Rays 
1d8 射线 
1 红Red。豁免失败：12d6点火焰伤害。豁免成功：半伤。 
2 橙Orange。豁免失败：12d6点强酸伤害。豁免成功：半伤。 
3 黄Yellow。豁免失败：12d6点闪电伤害。豁免成功：半伤。 
4 绿Green。豁免失败：12d6点毒素伤害。豁免成功：半伤。 
5 蓝Blue。豁免失败：12d6点寒冷伤害。豁免成功：半伤。 
6 靛Indigo。豁免失败：目标陷入束缚状态，且其每个回合结束进行一次体质豁免。在累计三次豁免成功后，状态终止。在累计三次豁免失败后，该生物被转化为石头陷入石化状态，直到此状态被高等复原术Greater Restoration 或类似效应解除为止。成功或失败的检定不需要连续；只要记录各情况的次数直至其中一方累计三次为止。 
7 紫Violet。豁免失败：目标陷入目盲 状态且在下一个你的回合开始时进行一次感知豁免。豁免成功，状态终止。豁免失败，状态终止，且该生物会被传送到另一个存在位面（由DM选择）。 
8 特殊Special。目标被两道射线击中。掷两次骰，若有骰子出目为8则重骰那颗骰子。
target:
Eight rays flash from your hand in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw. Roll 1d8 for each target to determine the ray that affects it, using the Prismatic Rays table.
Prismatic Rays
1d8 | Ray
1 | Red. Failed Save: 12d6 Fire damage. Successful Save: Half damage.
2 | Orange. Failed Save: 12d6 Acid damage. Successful Save: Half damage.
3 | Yellow. Failed Save: 12d6 Lightning damage. Successful Save: Half damage.
4 | Green. Failed Save: 12d6 Poison damage. Successful Save: Half damage.
5 | Blue. Failed Save: 12d6 Cold damage. Successful Save: Half damage.
6 | Indigo. Failed Save: The target has the Restrained condition and makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. After a total of three successful saves, the condition ends. After a total of three failed saves, the creature turns to stone and has the Petrified condition until Greater Restoration or a similar effect removes it. Successes and failures needn't be consecutive; track each until one reaches three.
7 | Violet. Failed Save: The target has the Blinded condition and makes a Wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the condition ends. On a failed save, the condition ends and the creature is transported to another plane of existence of the DM's choice.
8 | Special. The target is struck by two rays. Roll twice, rerolling any die that shows 8.
note: All eight ray rows retained with five damage types, nonconsecutive Indigo success/failure counters, its end-turn Constitution saves, and Violet's save at the start of your next turn. Violet ends blindness on both outcomes, and Special rerolls only dice showing 8.

source:
• 你与至多8个自愿生物在法术持续时间内进入昏迷，并梦见物质位面中的另一处世界，比如奥斯、托瑞尔、克莱恩或艾伯伦。如果该法术达到了完整的持续时间，梦境会在你们所有人相遇并拉开一面神秘的蓝色幕帘时停止。该法术随后结束，并将你们在物质和精神上传送到梦境所在的世界。
• 要施展该法术，你必须拥有一件源自目标世界的魔法物品，且你也必须知道这个世界的存在，即便你不知道那个世界的具体名字。你在另一个世界的目的地是该魔法物品创造地点周围1里内的安全地点。此外，如果其中一个受术目标出生在另一个世界，你也可以施展该法术，但目的地变为该生物出生地1里内的安全地点。
• 如果有一个生物受到任何伤害，则此法术在该生物身上提前结束，该生物不会被传送。如果你受到任何伤害，则你和其他所有生物身上的此法术会提前结束，你们都不会被传送。
context: column:M;spell:Dream of the Blue Veil;book:塔莎的万象坩埚;level:7
target:
• You and up to 8 willing creatures become unconscious for the duration and dream of another world on the Material Plane, such as Oerth, Toril, Krynn, or Eberron. If the spell lasts its full duration, the dream ends when all of you meet and draw aside a mysterious blue curtain. The spell then ends, transporting you bodily and spiritually to the world in the dream.
• To cast this spell, you must possess a magic item that originated in the destination world, and you must know that world exists even if you do not know its exact name. Your destination is a safe place within 1 li of where the item was created. Alternatively, you can cast the spell if one of its targets was born on another world; the destination is then a safe place within 1 li of that creature's birthplace.
• If a creature takes any damage, the spell ends early for that creature, and it is not transported. If you take any damage, the spell ends early for you and every other affected creature, and none of you are transported.

Parent target canonical SHA256 f87aa27a09141ae3e439a4d5ae3285b0b24b942b4140a10fedbd7c1cf4342620. Parent contextual note: Both bare li distances remain li pending unit review. Item-origin and native-creature alternatives, full-duration transport and individual versus caster damage interruptions are complete.

source:
• 七个星型的光点在你的头顶浮现并环绕，直到法术结束。你可以使用一个附赠动作消耗一个光点袭向在你120尺内的一个生物或物品。当你这么做时，进行一次远程法术攻击检定。若击中，目标受到4d12光耀伤害。无论你击中与否光点都将被消耗。如果你消耗了最后一枚光点，法术将提前结束。
• 如果你还留存4个或更多的光点，它们会发出30尺半径的明亮照明和额外30尺的微亮照明。如果你还留存1至3个光点，它们只会发出30尺的微光照明。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用8环或更高的法术位施放该法术时，使用的法术位每比7环高一环，你就可以多创造两枚额外的光点。
context: column:M;spell:Crown of Stars;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:7
target:
• Seven star-like motes appear and orbit your head until the spell ends. You can take a Bonus Action to expend a mote and send it at a creature or object within 120 feet of you, making a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 Radiant damage. The mote is expended whether you hit or miss. The spell ends early if you expend the last mote.
• While 4 or more motes remain, they shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. With 1 to 3 motes remaining, they shed only Dim Light for 30 feet.
• At Higher Levels: When cast with a level 8 or higher spell slot, you create two additional motes for each slot level above 7.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-006 44d87f47934cc1dcb34475af (2014 M453); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 82c1e47c2bec5597192a562827ea3512878ed4938e092a8149d2eb1870d1dbd9. Parent contextual note: Mote expenditure on hit or miss, creature/object targeting, last-mote ending and both illumination thresholds are complete.

source:
• 你说出饱含力量的真言，引发距离内一个你可见生物的剧痛。如果目标的生命值为100点或更少，它将遭受强烈的痛苦。否则，法术将对它没有作用。免疫魅惑的生物同样不受该法术影响。
• 如果目标承受了这种痛苦，他所拥有的任何速度都不能超过10尺。目标在攻击检定、属性检定和除了体质豁免以外的豁免检定中承受劣势。最后，如果目标试图施法，它必须先成功进行体质豁免检定，否则它将施法失败，法术会被浪费。
• 承受了这种痛苦的目标在它的每个回合结束都可以进行一次体质豁免检定。如果豁免成功，痛苦将结束。
context: column:M;spell:Power Word Pain;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:7
target:
• You speak a word of power that causes intense pain in a creature you can see within range. If it has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it suffers severe pain; otherwise, the spell has no effect. A creature immune to being charmed is also unaffected.
• While in this pain, none of the target's speeds can exceed 10 feet. It has Disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and all saving throws except Constitution saves. If it attempts to cast a spell, it must first succeed on a Constitution saving throw or the casting fails and the spell is wasted.
• At the end of each of its turns, a target suffering this pain can make a Constitution saving throw, ending the pain on a success.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-006 5dfa814f37af588fdfcce70d (2014 M465); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal.
