source:
• 你让一座神庙在闪耀的光辉中出现。选择施法距离内一处你可见的地面，为了容纳神庙这个空间必须是一个未被占用的立方体，每边至少120尺长。神庙维持到法术结束。它被用于供奉施法时所用圣徽体现的神明、众神或是哲学理念。
• 你可以对这座神庙的外观做出所有决定。它的内部被地板、墙壁和屋顶所包围，有一扇作为入口的门扉和任意数量的窗户，如你所愿。只有你或任何你在施法时指定的生物可以开启或关闭这扇门。
• 神庙的内部是个开放性空间，在一端摆放着神像或者是祭坛。你决定神庙是否被照亮，决定照亮神庙的是明亮光照还是微光光照。这里的温度适宜，熏香的气味弥漫在空气中。
• 在你施展该法术的时候，你选择数种生物类型被神庙所敌对。从以下列表中选择一项或更多：天界生物，元素生物，精类生物，邪魔，或是不死生物。如果选定类型的生物试图进入神庙，它必须立即进行一次魅力豁免检定。若豁免失败，他在24小时内不能进入神庙。即使生物能够进入神庙，魔法的力量也会妨碍它；每当它在神庙里进行攻击检定，属性检定或者是豁免检定时，它必须额外骰一个d4骰，把那个数值从d20的结果中减去。
• 此外，预言系法术所创造的传感器不能在神庙中出现，并且神庙里的生物无法被预言系法术定位。
• 最后，每次在神庙里的任何生物从1环或更高环的法术中恢复生命时，它将额外恢复等同于你感知调整值的额外生命值（至少1点）。
• 神庙由不透明的魔法力场所创造并延伸至以太位面，因此会阻碍任何试图从以太旅行中进入神庙内部的行为。没有东西能物理性地穿过神庙的外部。它不会被解除魔法Dispel Magic所解消，也不会受到反魔法力场Antimagic Field的影响。一道解离术Disintegrate能立即摧毁神庙。
• 如果你在一年中每天都对同一地点施展该法术，法术的效果将持续永久。
context: column:M;spell:Temple of the Gods;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:7
target:
• You cause a temple to appear in shimmering radiance. Choose a place on the ground that you can see within range. To accommodate the temple, the space must be an unoccupied cube at least 120 feet on each side. The temple lasts until the spell ends and is dedicated to the deity, deities, or philosophy represented by the Holy Symbol used in the casting.
• You decide every aspect of the temple's appearance. Its interior is enclosed by a floor, walls, and roof, with one entrance door and as many windows as you wish. Only you and creatures you designated when casting can open or close the door.
• The interior is an open space with an idol or altar at one end. You decide whether it is lit and whether that illumination is Bright Light or Dim Light. The temperature is comfortable, and incense fills the air.
• When you cast the spell, choose the creature types the temple opposes. Select one or more of these: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. A creature of a chosen type attempting to enter must immediately make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it cannot enter for 24 hours. Even if it enters, magical forces hinder it: whenever it makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw inside, it must roll an additional d4 and subtract that number from its d20 result.
• Sensors created by Divination spells cannot appear inside the temple, and creatures inside cannot be located by Divination spells.
• Whenever any creature in the temple regains Hit Points from a spell of level 1 or higher, it regains additional Hit Points equal to your Wisdom modifier, with a minimum of 1.
• The temple is made of opaque magical force and extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking attempts to enter through Ethereal travel. Nothing can physically pass through its exterior. Dispel Magic cannot end it, and Antimagic Field does not affect it. Disintegrate immediately destroys it.
• If you cast this spell in the same place every day for a year, its effect becomes permanent.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-006 f76b083897caadea3a547b7f (2014 M475); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 a8f97724c180127067f8611e3ab680998541d8d6915b755d387ca526253f2264. Parent contextual note: The source requires a cube at least 120 feet on each side; this is not changed to a maximum. Door permissions, selected-type entry/save penalties, Divination barriers, healing minimum and force exceptions are all complete.

• 一阵呼啸的旋风出现在你指定的地表上可见的一点。旋风半径为10尺，高度为30尺，是一个以指定点为中心的柱状体。直到此法术终结，你可以使用你的动作来在水平的任何方向上移动至多30尺。旋风会吸入所有固定或未被穿戴或持握的，不大于中型的物体。
• 在回合中第一次进入旋风的生物，或所在空间被旋风进入的生物（包括旋风第一次出现时的）必须进行一次敏捷豁免检定。豁免失败的生物受到10d6点钝击伤害，豁免成功者只受到上述伤害的一半。此外，体型不超过大型的生物若未通过豁免则必须通过一次力量豁免检定，否则会被旋风束缚，直到法术终结。当一个生物在被旋风束缚的条件下开始其回合时，除非其达到了顶点，其将被向上方推动5尺。被束缚的生物会随着旋风移动，而法术终结时其会摔落，除非其具有其他方法保持悬浮。
• 被束缚的生物可以使用一个动作来进行一次力量或敏捷检定，对抗你的法术豁免DC。若成功，该生物不再被旋风束缚，并被向随机方向抛离3d610尺远。
target:
• A roaring whirlwind appears at a point you choose that you can see on the ground. It is a Cylinder centered there, with a radius of 10 feet and a height of 30 feet. Until the spell ends, you can take an action to move the whirlwind up to 30 feet in any horizontal direction. It draws in all objects no larger than Medium that are fixed in place or are not being worn or held.
• A creature entering the whirlwind for the first time on a turn, or whose space the whirlwind enters, including when it first appears, must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 10d6 Bludgeoning damage; on a success, it takes half as much. In addition, a Large or smaller creature that fails must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the whirlwind until the spell ends. When a creature restrained this way starts its turn, it is lifted 5 feet higher unless it has reached the top. It moves with the whirlwind and falls when the spell ends unless it has another way to remain aloft.
• A restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength or Dexterity check against your spell save DC. On a success, it is no longer restrained by the whirlwind and is thrown 3d610 feet away in a random direction.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-006 3468795b25d859d3ab10b1ad (2014 M477); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Neither is repaired from a remembered rule. Entry timing, two successive saves and later escape check are complete.

• 伴随着一声咆哮，你用龙族的魔法变化自身，获得多种龙族特征。直至法术结束，你获得以下增益：
→盲视：你获得30尺盲视。此范围内，任何不处于全身掩护后的东西对于你来说清晰可见，即使你处于目盲状态或黑暗中。此外，你可以看见隐形的生物，除非该生物对你处于躲藏状态。
→吐息武器：当你施展此法术时，以及在法术持续时间内随后的回合内，你能用一个附赠动作呼出闪光能量并覆盖60尺锥形区域。区域内的每个生物都必须成功通过一次敏捷豁免，否则受到6d8点力场伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
→飞翼：虚体的飞翼从你背后长出，使你获得60尺飞行速度。
context: column:M;spell:Draconic Transformation;book:费茨本的巨龙宝库;level:7
target:
• With a roar, you transform yourself through draconic magic and gain several draconic traits. Until the spell ends, you gain these benefits:
→ Blindsight: You gain Blindsight out to 30 feet. Within that range, you can clearly see anything not behind Total Cover, even if you are blinded or in darkness. You can also see invisible creatures unless they are hidden from you.
→ Breath Weapon: When you cast this spell and on subsequent turns for its duration, you can take a Bonus Action to exhale shimmering energy in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d8 Force damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
→ Wings: Incorporeal wings grow from your back, giving you a Fly Speed of 60 feet.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-006 7c589558d1cea67eb87966c6 (2014 M478); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 30151352baf720c16e9e7dd4a947a791264d996fc41ec6223826ed689942dd97. Parent contextual note: All three traits remain. The source groups the casting-time and subsequent-turn breath under the Bonus Action wording; the translation does not invent a separate free initial breath.

• 两个施法距离内的你能看见的生物必须进行一次体质豁免，若两者在30尺内，则他们的豁免检定具有劣势。每个生物都能自愿放弃豁免。若两者中有一个豁免成功了，那么法术没有效果。若两人豁免均失败了，那么他们便会在法术持续时间内魔法般地被连接在一起，无论两人间距多少。 若其中一人受到伤害 ，另外一人也会受到等额的伤害。若其中一人恢复了生命值，另外一人也会恢复等额的生命值。
• 如果被系结的双方中任意一方的HP减少到了0，那么该法术结束。该法术在任意一方身上结束时，另外一方的法术也结束。
target:
• Two creatures you can see within range must make Constitution saving throws. If they are within 30 feet of each other, they have Disadvantage on these saves. Either creature can willingly forgo its save. If either succeeds, the spell has no effect. If both fail, they are magically linked for the duration, regardless of the distance between them. When one takes damage, the other takes an equal amount of damage. When one regains Hit Points, the other regains an equal amount.
• If either linked creature's HP drops to 0, the spell ends. If the spell ends on either creature, it also ends on the other.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-006 c97ed7bc6c634a792ba2d681 (2014 M476); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent contextual note: Both-fail requirement, proximity disadvantage, voluntary failure, unrestricted subsequent separation, equal damage/healing and linked ending remain.

• 你从以距离内由你指定的一点为中心、30尺立方空间内的每个生物身上抽取水汽。在该区域内的每个生物必须进行一次体质豁免检定。构装生物和不死生物不受影响，而植物和水元素在进行此豁免检定时具有劣势。若豁免失败，生物将受到12d8点黯蚀伤害，而豁免成功则只受到上述伤害的一半。
• 在这个区域内的非魔法、非生物植物，例如树木和灌木，会立即死亡。
context: column:M;spell:Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:8
target:
• You draw moisture from each creature in a 30-foot cube centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. Constructs and Undead are unaffected, while Plants and Water Elementals have Disadvantage on the save. On a failure, a creature takes 12d8 Necrotic damage; on a success, it takes half as much.
• Nonmagical plants in the area that are not creatures, such as trees and shrubs, die immediately.

• 你汇聚、编织从堕影冥界收集的阴影物质，随后在施法距离内你可见的未占据空间创造出巨型阴影龙。这个幻象会占据所在空间并持续到法术结束，就好像是一个真实生物。
• 当幻象出现时，任何可以看见幻象的你的敌人必须成功进行感知豁免检定，否则将在1分钟内陷入恐惧。如果被恐惧的生物在与幻象没有视觉线相连的位置并结束回合，它可以重新进行豁免检定，成功将终止对自己的恐惧效果。
• 在你的回合中以一个附赠动作，你可以移动幻象最多60尺。选择它进行移动的任意一点，你可以使它以那个位置作为起源点并喷吐出60尺锥形的爆发性能量。在你创造巨龙时选择一种伤害类型：强酸，冷冻，火焰，闪电，黯蚀或者毒素。处于锥形范围内的每个生物必须进行智力豁免检定，若豁免失败会受到7d6点对应类型的伤害，成功只承受一半。
• 幻象是有形的因为它由阴影物质创造而成，不过对它的攻击会自动失手。它会通过所有豁免检定，并且免疫所有的伤害和异常状态。一个生物可以用动作来进行智力（调查）检定对抗你的法术豁免DC来判断巨龙是否为幻影。如果生物识别了幻象的真相，生物可以看穿它并在对抗它的吐息时获得优势。
context: column:M;spell:Illusory Dragon;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:8
target:
• You gather and weave shadow material collected from the Shadowfell, then create a Huge shadow dragon in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The illusion occupies its space and lasts until the spell ends, as though it were a real creature.
• When the illusion appears, any of your enemies that can see it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. If a frightened creature ends its turn in a location with no line of sight to the illusion, it can repeat the save, ending the frightened effect on itself on a success.
• As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 60 feet. At any point along its movement, you can have it breathe a 60-foot cone of explosive energy originating from that location. Choose a damage type when you create the dragon: acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, or poison. Each creature in the cone must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking 7d6 damage of the chosen type on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
• The illusion is tangible because it is made from shadow material, but attacks against it automatically miss. It succeeds on all saving throws and is immune to all damage and conditions. A creature can use an action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to determine whether the dragon is an illusion. If it recognizes the illusion for what it is, it can see through the dragon and has advantage against its breath.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-007 e8e5ee99b0d1f6dc43668ef4 (2014 M492); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 e8bf30c63c57456b853f1f8608527010f933102d24fb39703cc7531e0afa4442. Parent contextual note: M492, Xanathar's Guide to Everything, level 8. Full frightened-repeat-save and moving breath branches retained, including all six damage types. The source's final advantage wording is left broad ('against its breath') rather than adding a missing save qualifier from memory.

• 魔法黑暗从范围内你指定的一点延伸至半径60尺的球形范围，直到法术结束。黑暗会蔓延过拐角。生物的黑暗视觉不能看穿这片黑暗。非魔法的光源，以及8环和8环以下法术创造的光亮不能照亮这片区域。
• 尖叫声，低语声，以及疯狂的大笑声时不时能从球形范围内听见。每当一名生物在范围内开始回合，它必须进行一次感知豁免，失败时将受到8d8心灵伤害，成功则只承受一半。
context: column:M;spell:Maddening Darkness;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:8
target:
• Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range into a sphere with a 60-foot radius until the spell ends. The darkness spreads around corners. Creatures cannot see through it with darkvision. Nonmagical light and light created by spells of level 8 or lower cannot illuminate the area.
• Screams, whispers, and mad laughter can be heard from the sphere from time to time. Whenever a creature starts its turn in the area, it must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 8d8 psychic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-007 efa96f99fa9cc184964d87a6 (2014 M494); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. • 一座岩石的堡垒从施法距离内你选择的一处可见的方形地面升起。这块区域需要在每一边上有至少120尺，并且必须没有任何建筑或其他构造物立于其上。所有处于区域内的生物在堡垒升起时将会被无害地举起。
• 这座堡垒有4个方形的塔楼，每一个都有20尺的边长和30尺的高度，分布在堡垒的每个角上。塔楼通过每边80尺长的石墙相互连接，创造出一个封闭的区域。每一面墙的厚度都达到1尺，由10尺宽度和20尺高度的石板组成。每块石板都与其他两块石板或是与一块石板和一座塔楼相邻接。你可以在堡垒的外墙放置4面石门。
• 在封闭区域内树立着一座小城堡。城堡拥有50尺边长的方形基座，并且有3层楼，每一层的天花板都有10尺高。每一层都可以以你喜欢的方式划分出许多房间，但每个房间都至少要有5尺的边长。城堡的每一层都由石头楼梯相连，它的墙厚达6英寸，室内房间的门户式样（石门或者开放式拱门）由你选择。城堡内部的家具和装潢以你喜欢的方式布置，它每天可以提供足够100人享用的、包含九道菜肴的盛宴。从堡垒中被带走的家具、食物和其他由该法术创造的物体会立即化为土灰。
• 你在施展法术时可以指定任意生物，有100个隐形的侍从作为堡垒的职工遵从他们的任何命令。每一个侍从都如同隐形仆役法术的造物，有近似的功能。
• 所有由石头创造的城墙、塔楼和城堡都会被损害。每一块10尺x10尺的岩石部件都有15点AC，以及每英寸厚度30点的生命值。它免疫毒素和心灵伤害。将某一部分的岩石生命值降低至0点会摧毁它，并且也许会引起与它连接的部分变形和垮塌，具体由你的DM裁量。
• 在7天之后，或当你在别处再次施展该法术，堡垒会无害地坍塌并沉入地面，把其中的任何生物安全地留在地上。
• 在一年之间，每7天一次在相同的位置施展该法术会让堡垒永久存在。
context: column:M;spell:Mighty Fortress;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:8
target:
• A stone fortress rises from a square area of ground you choose and can see within range. The area must measure at least 120 feet on each side and have no buildings or other structures standing on it. All creatures in the area are harmlessly lifted as the fortress rises.
• The fortress has 4 square towers, each 20 feet on a side and 30 feet high, with one at each corner. Stone walls 80 feet long connect the towers on each side, creating an enclosed area. Each wall is 1 foot thick and consists of panels 10 feet wide and 20 feet high. Each panel adjoins either two other panels or a panel and a tower. You can place 4 stone doors in the fortress's outer walls.
• A keep stands within the enclosed area. It has a square base 50 feet on a side and 3 floors, each with a ceiling 10 feet high. You can divide each floor into rooms however you like, but each room must be at least 5 feet on a side. Stone stairs connect the floors. The keep's walls are 6 inches thick, and you choose the style of the interior doorways: stone doors or open archways. You arrange the interior furnishings and decor as you wish. Each day, it can provide a nine-course feast sufficient for 100 people. Furnishings, food, and other objects created by this spell turn to dust immediately if taken out of the fortress.
• You can designate any creatures when you cast the spell. A staff of 100 invisible servants obeys their commands. Each servant functions much like a creation of the Unseen Servant spell.
• All the stone walls, towers, and the keep can be damaged. Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of stone has AC 15 and 30 hit points per inch of thickness. It is immune to poison and psychic damage. Reducing a section of stone to 0 hit points destroys it and might cause connected sections to buckle and collapse, as determined by your DM.
• After 7 days, or when you cast this spell again elsewhere, the fortress harmlessly collapses and sinks into the ground, leaving any creatures inside safely on the ground.
• Casting this spell in the same location once every 7 days for a year makes the fortress permanent.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-007 90be79a8e5d4073b3ee0a911 (2014 M496); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 f7703ffb044f2661a5234bf4f3b7fb002e078706fc23151a28532930468a6cc1. Parent contextual note: M496, Xanathar's Guide to Everything, level 8. Complete architecture, servants, meals, object removal, section durability, collapse, and permanence rules retained. 'At least 120 feet' follows the actual source. Explicit source inches are translated as inches; no bare-unit assumption is needed. Phase 19 root and independent review: Within the fortress adds a command-location limitation absent from this source sentence. Delete only that phrase; do not add unrestricted travel, change the Unseen Servant comparison, or alter the separate rule for objects taken from the fortress.

• 该法术在施法距离内以你选择的一点为圆心创造一个球形范围。该圆形半径至多为40尺。区域内充斥着魔法黑暗与毁灭性的重力能量。
• 法术持续时间内，球形区域内视为困难地形。一个拥有黑暗视觉的生物没法看透这片魔法黑暗，非魔法的光源无法点亮这片区域。该区域内没法发出声音，声音也没办法穿过该区域。任何完全处于该区域内的生物或物件免疫雷鸣伤害，并且生物完全处于该区域内时处于耳聋状态。在该法术的影响范围内没有办法施展需要语言成分的法术。
• 任何在自己回合中第一次进入该区域的生物或在该区域内开始其回合的生物需要进行一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，该生物受到8d10点力场伤害，成功则只受到一半伤害。当一个生物的HP被该法术降低到0时，该生物被解离。被解离的生物与其身上穿着的，携带着的一切，除了魔法物品外，都会化为一缕灰色的烟尘。
target:
• This spell creates a sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Its radius is up to 40 feet. The area is filled with magical darkness and destructive gravitational energy.
• For the spell's duration, the sphere is difficult terrain. A creature with darkvision cannot see through this magical darkness, and nonmagical light cannot illuminate it. Sound cannot be produced inside the area or pass through it. Any creature or object entirely inside the area is immune to thunder damage, and creatures entirely inside it are deafened. Spells that require verbal components cannot be cast within the spell's area.
• Any creature that enters the area for the first time on its own turn or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 8d10 force damage, or half as much on a success. A creature whose HP is reduced to 0 by this spell is disintegrated. The disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing or carrying, except magic items, become a wisp of gray dust.
note: Exact reuse from reviewed 2014-spells-007 97d4221fdd1710cf3c45799d (2014 M485); actual M/N/B and X(2014)/Z(2024) are all exactly equal. Parent target canonical SHA256 106b7c916ffe6815399f9ac04c5f273f442e727e2557fac2d1c7120b6c75f601. Parent contextual note: M485, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount, level 8. Retains the source's own-turn entry trigger, entirely-inside qualifications for immunity/deafness, component restriction, and disintegration exception; no different-edition wording was substituted.

source:
• 你将现实与时间线之间的壁垒粉碎，使一个生物陷入混沌与疯狂。目标必须通过一个感知豁免，否则将无法执行任何反应直到法术结束。被影响的生物必须在其回合开始时roll一个d10，其结果决定目标身上发生了什么，参照下方表格“崩坏现实效果”。
• 在其回合结束时，受影响的生物能重复其感知豁免，若成功，则法术结束。

崩坏现实效果
d10   效果
1–2   遥远国度之瞥。目标受到6d12点心灵伤害并且陷入震慑到本轮结束。
3–5   崩碎裂缝。目标必须通过一个敏捷豁免，若失败则受到8d12点力场伤害，若豁免成功则受到一半伤害。
6–8   虫洞。该目标与其身上所着装、携带的一切东西被传送到他30尺内你能看到的未被占据的空间。目标受到12d10点力场伤害并倒地。
9–10   暗虚之冻。 目标受到12d10点冷冻伤害并且目盲到本回合结束。
target:
• You shatter the barriers between reality and timelines, plunging a creature into chaos and madness. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take reactions until the spell ends. At the start of its turn, an affected creature must roll a d10 to determine what happens to it, using the Reality Break Effects table below.
• At the end of its turn, the affected creature can repeat its Wisdom saving throw, ending the spell on a success.

Reality Break Effects
d10   Effect
1–2   Vision of the Far Realm. The target takes 6d12 psychic damage and is stunned until the end of the current round.
3–5   Rending Rift. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d12 force damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
6–8   Wormhole. The target and everything it is wearing or carrying are teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of it. The target takes 12d10 force damage and falls prone.
9–10   Chill of the Dark Void. The target takes 12d10 cold damage and is blinded until the end of the current turn.

• 你可以转变施法距离内最多10个由你选择的可见生物。非自愿的目标必须通过一次感知豁免检定来对抗变形。非自愿的变形者（shapechanger）在这次豁免中自动成功。
• 每一个目标都获得由你选择的、相同或是不同的野兽形态。新的形态可以是你曾见过的、挑战等级低于或等于目标挑战等级任意野兽（如果目标没有挑战等级，那么上限是目标等级的一半）。这些目标的游戏数据，包括心智属性值，将被你所选择的野兽数据所取代，但仍然保留他们的生命值、阵营和人格。
• 每一个目标都得到等同于新形态生命值的临时生命值。这些临时生命值不能被其他来源的临时生命值替换。生物会在失去这些临时生命值或者死亡时变回原本的形态。如果法术在这之前结束，这些临时生命值也会失去且生物变回原形。
• 生物能进行的动作被它新形态的特质所限制。它将不能说话、施展法术、或是做其他需要用到手或言语的事情。
• 目标的装备融合进新形态，目标生物不能启动，使用，挥舞或其他方式从它的装备上获得增益。
context: column:M;spell:Mass Polymorph;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:9
target:
• You can transform up to 10 creatures of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist the transformation. An unwilling shapechanger automatically succeeds on this save.
• Each target takes a beast form you choose, which can be the same as or different from the others' forms. The new form can be any beast you have seen whose challenge rating is no greater than the target's challenge rating, or half its level if it has no challenge rating. The target's game statistics, including its mental ability scores, are replaced by the chosen beast's statistics, but it retains its hit points, alignment, and personality.
• Each target gains temporary hit points equal to the hit points of its new form. These temporary hit points cannot be replaced by temporary hit points from another source. The creature returns to its original form when it loses these temporary hit points or dies. If the spell ends first, the temporary hit points are lost and the creature returns to its original form.
• The creature's actions are limited by the capabilities of its new form. It cannot speak, cast spells, or do anything else requiring hands or speech.
• The target's equipment merges into its new form. The creature cannot activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

• 你释放你的心灵力量，轰击施法距离内至多10个由你选择的可见生物的心智。智力值为2或更低的生物不受影响。
• 每个目标都必须进行一次智力豁免检定。若豁免失败，目标受到14d6心灵伤害并且被震慑。豁免成功则只承受一半且不被震慑。如果一个有头的目标被这个伤害杀死，它的头会爆炸。
• 一个被震慑的生物可以在它每个回合结束时重新进行智力豁免。若豁免成功，震慑效果将结束。

• You unleash your psychic power to assault the minds of up to 10 creatures you choose and can see within range. Creatures with an Intelligence score of 2 or lower are unaffected.
• Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 14d6 psychic damage and is stunned. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not stunned. If this damage kills a target that has a head, its head explodes.
• A stunned creature can repeat the Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the stunned effect on a success.

• 你以施法距离内你可见的一点为源点创造一个半径20尺的毁灭性球形力场。在法术持续时间内，球形力场与其100尺范围内的空间视为困难地形，且完全处于力场内的未被着装与携带的非魔法物件会被摧毁。
• 当力场出现时或者在你的每回合开始时，力场的100尺范围内未被着装的物件将被直直拉向力场的中心，并在距离力场中心最近的未被占据的空间停止。
• 当一个生物在力场的100尺范围内开始其回合时，其必须进行一个力量豁免，若失败则将被直直拉向力场的中心，并在距离力场中心最近的未被占据的空间停止。一个在当前回合内第一次进入力场的生物或在力场内开始其回合的生物会受到5d10点力场伤害并且被束缚，直到其离开力场范围。若力场位于空中，那么被束缚的生物将会在力场中悬浮。一个生物能以其动作进行一个对抗你的法术豁免DC的力量检定，若成功则能解除其自己或者另一个在其触及范围内的力场内的生物的束缚状态。若一个生物的HP被该法术降低至0，他与他身上携带的所有非魔法物件都会被湮灭。
target:
• You create a destructive spherical field of force with a 20-foot radius, originating at a point you can see within range. For the spell's duration, the sphere and the space within 100 feet of it are difficult terrain. Nonmagical objects entirely inside the sphere that are neither worn nor carried are destroyed.
• When the sphere appears and at the start of each of your turns, objects within 100 feet of the sphere that are not being worn are pulled straight toward its center, stopping in the nearest unoccupied space to the center.
• A creature that starts its turn within 100 feet of the sphere must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is pulled straight toward the sphere's center and stops in the nearest unoccupied space to the center. A creature that enters the sphere for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside it takes 5d10 force damage and is restrained until it leaves the sphere. If the sphere is in the air, restrained creatures float inside it. A creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, ending the restrained condition on itself or another creature inside the sphere and within its reach on a success. If this spell reduces a creature's HP to 0, it and all nonmagical objects it is carrying are annihilated.

source: • 你选定一个施法距离内的目标，使他的身体形态受到飞速衰老的破坏。目标必须进行一个体质豁免并在豁免失败时受到12d10点黯蚀伤害, 或在豁免成功时只受到一半的伤害。若其豁免失败，目标还会快速老化至离老死只有三十天的时间点。在这个年龄段, 目标在攻击检定, 属性检定与豁免检定上承受劣势，其步行速度也减少一半。只有祈愿术Wish或以九环法术位施展的高等复原术Greater Restoration才能使这些效果消除并使其恢复原先的年龄。
target: • You choose a target within range and ravage its physical form with rapid aging. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 12d10 necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. On a failed save, the target also rapidly ages to the point where it has only thirty days left before dying of old age. At this age, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and its walking speed is halved. Only Wish or Greater Restoration cast using a ninth-level spell slot can remove these effects and restore its original age.
